title: AI Infrastructure Infographic Poster
content:
Goal: Create a highly polished vertical educational infographic titled {{headline_text}} with the subtitle {{subtitle_text}}, explaining modern AI infrastructure from data pipelines and GPU training clusters to inference serving, batching, and KV cache.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, dark navy futuristic data-center aesthetic. Use a glowing blue/purple cyber grid background with mountains, server racks, a GPU chip illustration, neon circuit traces, thin rounded panels, white and cyan typography, and small orange numbered badges. The overall look should resemble a premium technical explainer poster, dense but readable.

Layout: Large title across the top left, small subtitle and tagline below it, decorative server racks and GPU chip on the top right. Arrange the content into exactly 8 numbered main sections plus a right-side “Key Concepts” column and a bottom flow footer. Use precise panel borders, small icons, arrows, diagrams, tables, and micro-labels.

Sections and required content:
1. Data Pipeline: Show exactly 5 pipeline stages connected by arrows: Raw Data Sources, Ingestion & Cleaning, Labeling / Curation, Tokenization / Chunking, and Sharding & Storage. Raw Data Sources contains exactly 5 bullets: Web pages, Documents, Code, Images, Logs. Ingestion & Cleaning contains exactly 3 bullets: Filtering, Deduplication, Normalization. Labeling / Curation contains exactly 3 bullets: Quality checks, Human / heuristic, Dataset assembly. Tokenization / Chunking contains exactly 3 bullets: Convert text to tokens, Chunk into docs, Add special tokens. Sharding & Storage contains exactly 3 bullets: Split into shards, Balanced partitions, Optimized for parallel reads. Add a caption stating that data is cleaned, deduplicated, curated, tokenized, and stored in shards so many workers can read it efficiently.

2. Storage + Orchestration Layer: Include exactly 3 vertical cards: Object Storage with a cloud-to-database icon and note “S3 / GCS / Azure Blob or on-prem object store”; Metadata / Experiment Tracking with a dashboard icon and bullets “Runs & metrics,” “Hyperparameters,” “Lineage & artifacts”; Monitoring & Logging with a chart/magnifier icon and bullets “Metrics & alerts,” “Logs aggregation,” “Tracing & debugging.” Add a footer note that the control layer coordinates compute jobs, tracks experiments, stores checkpoints, and monitors utilization, failures, and costs.

3. Training Cluster Architecture: Large central architecture diagram titled Training Cluster Architecture. Show exactly 4 GPU / Accelerator Node boxes in a 2x2 grid connected by glowing high-speed network links labeled “High-Speed Network InfiniBand / RoCE.” Each node contains CPU Host (Multi-core), RAM, GPUs such as 8x H100, and NVMe local SSD. Add dotted links between nodes. Below, include exactly 3 mini-panels: Inside a Node, Data Parallelism, and Distributed Training Parallelism (Legend). Inside a Node should show CPU connected by PCIe/NVLink/NVSwitch lines to multiple GPUs. Distributed Training Parallelism legend should show exactly 4 stages labeled Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4.

4. The Training Step: Create a left-to-right training flow with exactly 6 stages: Input Tokens, Forward Pass, Loss Compute, Backward Pass, Gradients, Optimizer Update. Include a checkpointing icon stack, a “Model Precision” box mentioning FP32, FP16/BF16, FP8, and an “Optimizer State” box. Show gradient accumulation arrows and a caption explaining that during training, the model predicts outputs, computes loss, propagates gradients backward, and updates weights, repeated billions of times.

5. Inference Serving Pipeline: Create a compact serving diagram with exactly 6 stages across the top: User Request, API Gateway, Tokenizer, Scheduler / Router, Model Server (GPU), Streamed Output. Inside the panel include Dynamic Batching with exactly 3 request rows, a Model Server box showing Prefill and Decode Loop, KV Cache on GPU Memory, optional adapters, and a load balancer connecting exactly 3 model replicas labeled Model Replica 1, Model Replica 2, Model Replica N.

6. Operations, Reliability, and Safety: Include exactly 6 operational cards with icons: Autoscaling, Telemetry / Observability, Rate Limiting & Quotas, Safety Filters / Guardrails, Versioning / Rollback, Cost Monitoring. Add a note that production AI systems need strong operational tooling to remain reliable, safe, and cost-efficient.

7. Training vs Inference: Add a comparison table with exactly 6 rows: Goal, Main Bottleneck, Memory Focus, Typical Metric, Scale Pattern, Resilience Needs. Use two columns labeled Training and Inference (Serving). Training should describe learning model weights from data, distributed compute and data movement bandwidth, activations/gradients/optimizer states, tokens per second or convergence, large batch long jobs, and checkpointing/fault tolerance. Inference should describe generating useful responses for users, latency and throughput, model weights plus KV cache, latency and tokens per second, many short requests, and high availability/graceful degradation.

8. Key Concepts right column: Create a tall right sidebar titled Key Concepts containing exactly 5 lettered cards: A. Batch Size, B. Sequence Length / Context Window, C. KV Cache, D. Throughput vs Latency, E. Parameters / Weights / Activations. Card A should define batch size and show small batch versus large batch with token/person icons. Card B should show prompt tokens and long context as token blocks labeled T1, T2, T3, T4, …, Tn. Card C should show prompt tokens feeding a purple cylindrical KV Cache, then a new token reading from cache. Card D should show exactly 2 gauges: Throughput and Latency. Card E should show weights and activations as blue and purple grids connected by multiplication. At the bottom of the sidebar add a small “Prefill vs Decode” note explaining prefill processes the full prompt and decode generates one token at a time using the KV cache.

Footer: Add a bottom navigation strip with the sequence “DATA → TRAINING → INFERENCE → VALUE,” a small circular rocket/compass-style icon at left, and a closing quote: {{footer_quote}}

Visual style: Dense corporate technical infographic, crisp vector and semi-3D icons, glowing cyan outlines, subtle gradients, volumetric light, small schematics, miniature charts, and clean serif title typography with modern sans-serif labels. The color palette should be {{color_palette}}.

Constraints: Use exactly 8 numbered main sections, exactly 5 key concept cards, exactly 4 GPU nodes, exactly 6 training-step stages, exactly 6 inference stages, exactly 6 operations cards, and exactly 6 training-vs-inference table rows. Keep all visible text in English, avoid watermarks, avoid brand logos, and maintain high readability despite the dense layout.

Show ornate European old-town architecture with pastel townhouses along the back and right edges, red tiled roofs, decorative gables, cobblestone paving, and soft shallow-depth-of-field lighting. The main landmarks should be a long Renaissance cloth hall with arcaded sides and an ornate roofline, plus a large brick Gothic basilica with exactly 2 unequal tall towers, dark spires, onion domes, and gilded details. In the open square include exactly 1 central stone monument with a standing statue, exactly 5 horse-drawn carriages, exactly 6 small market stalls or flower kiosks with pale yellow awnings, and exactly 7 white café umbrellas around outdoor seating. Fill the plaza with many tiny colorful pedestrians in summer clothing, clustered naturally around stalls, cafés, the monument, carriages, and church entrances. Use {{visual_style}}, with warm sunlight, crisp shadows, rich brick and pastel colors, tiny flowers and greenery, and a charming lunch-time tourist atmosphere. Avoid readable signage, modern cars, oversized people, watermarks, or text overlays.

title: Playful Hanfu Graduation Photo Grid
content:
Based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, generate a 2x2 collage photoshoot with a 3:4 aspect ratio per image, themed around '{{theme}}'.

[Character Consistency]
Strictly preserve the user's real identity features, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, age appearance, hairstyle foundation, and overall temperament. In all four small images, it must clearly look like the same real girl, not a stranger, not Westernized, not overly airbrushed, and without an AI 'fake face' look.

[Overall Style]
New Chinese-style graduation photo style popular on Chinese social media, featuring playful, agile, energetic, cute, and pleasing vibes. The image should look like a relaxed and fun set of creative graduation photos suitable for sharing, generally clean and bright with a subtle Chinese sweet aesthetic.

[Makeup]
Sweet and clear youth makeup. Light and transparent base with natural skin color. Eye makeup in light apricot pink, peach pink, or warm brown tones with soft eyeliner and naturally curled lashes. Peach or apple pink blush, and cream pink, peach, or coral lip color. Overall look should be young and lively.

[Hairstyle]
Natural extension of original hair length from uploaded photos, but prioritized for styles that fit graduation caps decorated with flowers.
- Long hair: Semi-updo, double side braids, low double buns, or soft updo with loose strands.
- Mid-length hair: Half-tied, double braids, or low position updo.
- Short hair: Tucked behind ears or French short curls with small flower caps.
Avoid heavy hair covering the cap or face in all four images.

[Clothing & Accessories]
Playful Hanfu graduation outfits in light green, pink-white, light yellow, or milk white colors. Lightweight fabrics with embroidery, wraps, wide sleeves, and pattern details. Must pair with a flower-decorated academic cap or graduation hat with minor tassels.

[Scene & Props]
Clean and bright Chinese-style studio space with beige, warm white, or light wood backgrounds. Decorative elements include cherry blossom branches, small wooden tables, flower vases, books, and scrolls. Props include brushes, scrolls, and wooden quote boards using traditional Chinese calligraphy like 'Happy Graduation' or 'Bright Future'.

[Lighting & Texture]
Soft and bright lighting, overall clear and gentle. Detailed fabric and accessory textures. A slight soft focus effect, but not sharp or commercial advertisement style.

[Fixed 4-Grid Shots]
1. Top-Left: Close-up main vision. Person looking at the camera with a gentle smile, holding a small wooden quote board. Focus on facial identity and cap.
2. Top-Right: Full body pose. Showing the full outfit and cap, holding a brush and scroll with a natural bright smile. Agile posture.
3. Bottom-Left: Playful action shot. 3/4 side view, tilting head or winking to emphasize playfulness.
4. Bottom-Right: Interaction with books/scrolls. Seated or leaning on a table, reading or looking at the camera gently with foreground flowers for depth.

[Consistency]
Keep the person, outfit, cap, makeup, and scene color consistent across all four images.

title: Refined Academic Degree Graduation Photos
content: # 新中式学位袍毕业写真｜4张单独精修照 请基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰个人照片，一次性生成 **4 张不同的单独精修毕业写真照片**。 主题为： 「新中式[学位等级]学位袍毕业写真」 可替换参数： - [学位等级]：学士 / 硕士 / 博士 - [专业类别]：文学 / 理学 / 工学 / 农学 / 医学 / 管理学 / 艺术学 / 法学 / 教育学 / 经济学 / 历史学 / 哲学 / 军事学 - [主体配色]：默认按中国学位服常见体系处理，也可按学校实际版本微调 - [道具偏好]：花束 / 古代书卷 / 古籍 / 毛笔 / 题词卷轴 / 小木牌 / 簪花团扇 - [背景类型]：A 简约复古浅棕棚拍背景；B 梦幻绿色金色散景背景 - [人物气质]：甜美 / 清冷 / 温柔 / 俏皮 / 书卷气 / 元气 ## 1｜输出形式 一次性输出 4 张彼此不同的单独照片。 每张都是独立成片： - 竖构图 - 3:4 比例 - 上半身 / 半身 / 3/4 身为主 - 突出人物、帽子、盘发、簪花、衣领、袖口、前衣襟和书卷道具 ## 2｜人物一致性 请严格保留用户本人真实身份特征，包括： - 脸型 - 五官比例 - 眼睛形状 - 鼻子形状 - 嘴唇形状 - 肤色 - 年龄感 - 发型基础气质 - 整体神态 4 张图都必须清楚看起来是同一个真实女生。 不要变成陌生人，不要欧美化，不要网红化，不要过度磨皮，不要假脸，不要把人物变成 AI 模特。 ## 3｜核心风格定位 这是一组 新中式学位袍毕业写真。 画面必须同时具备： 1. 明确毕业主题 2. 标准学位帽与学位袍识别度 3. 新中式汉服细节 4. 盘发与真花簪花 5. 古代书卷道具 6. 温柔、精致、少女感、毕业季传播感 视觉逻辑是： 保留学位袍大身结构，在领口、袖口、前衣襟、帽饰和道具上加入新中式审美。 ## 4｜服装硬性要求 服装必须是 新中式[学位等级]学位袍。 ### 必须保留 - 标准中国学位袍 / 毕业袍的大身轮廓 - 黑色或深色学位袍主体 - 学位袍的宽袖结构 - 学位袍肩部与披肩感结构 - 学位帽与流苏 ### 必须加强的新中式细节 请明显加强以下位置的汉服设计： - 衣领 - 袖口 - 前衣襟 - 胸前局部结构 - 局部滚边 - 局部刺绣 - 盘扣 / 中式结扣 - 云肩感细节 - 交领或立领层次 - 袖口内衬层次 衣服要有更明显的新中式精致感，但仍然能一眼看出是毕业学位袍。 ### 专业色要求 [专业类别] 对应 [专业色]。 [专业色] 只用于： - 衣领 - 袖口 - 前衣襟 - 局部滚边 - 帽饰花材 - 流苏附近小装饰 - 书卷绑带 不要把整件袍子改成彩色汉服。 ## 5｜发型硬性要求 发型必须是 盘发造型。 优先选择： - 低盘发 - 低松髻 - 半扎盘发 - 编发盘发 - 低挽发 - 带碎发的中式盘发 要求： - 头发必须明显收起来 - 耳后和后脑要能看出盘发结构 - 可以有少量自然碎发修饰脸型 - 如果用户照片是短发，把头发收到耳后 - 不要长发大面积披在肩上 - 不要完全散发 - 不要日常松散披发 - 不要湿发感 - 不要现代网红大波浪披发 ## 6｜学位帽与真花簪花 必须保留标准方形学位帽： - 黑色方形帽 - 帽型清晰 - 流苏清晰 - 真花簪花突出，但花不能完全遮住学位帽 帽子和盘发处必须有 明显真花簪花。 簪花要求： - 花量比普通小发饰更多 - 必须是真花质感 - 可以使用粉色、白色、奶油色、浅杏色小花 - 有真实花瓣层次 - 有花蕊、花茎、绿叶、小花枝 - 可以有少量垂坠花枝或珍珠感小吊坠 - 花饰要明显，但不要遮挡五官和帽型 不要塑料花，不要廉价珠花，不要普通发夹感。 ## 7｜道具要求 主要道具必须使用 古代书卷 / 卷轴。 优先道具： - 古代书卷 - 卷轴 - 毛笔 - 团扇 - 线装书 - 小木牌 - “不讀了”题词卷 书卷要求： - 纸张为米白色、宣纸感、微微泛黄 - 有木轴或卷轴头 - 可用粉色丝带轻轻系住 - 可以有浅淡花纹或山水纹理 允许出现的繁体书法字： - 不讀了 - 畢業快樂 - 前程似錦 - 金榜題名 - 書香長存 文字必须是书法感，不能是现代海报字体。 ## 8｜妆容要求 妆容为精致但不过分浓艳的新中式少女妆： - 清透底妆 - 保留真实皮肤质感 - 柔和眼妆 - 自然睫毛 - 豆沙粉、裸粉、柔雾玫瑰粉唇色 - 轻微腮红 - 温柔、干净、元气 不要韩式网红浓妆，不要影楼大浓妆，不要过度磨皮，不要塑料皮肤。 ## 9｜背景与摄影语言 背景采用简约、干净、衬托人物的布景，不需要复杂场景，不强调露腿，不需要大空间环境。 可从以下两类背景中统一选择其一： - A 类：简约复古浅棕 / 奶咖 / 油画感棚拍背景 - B 类：梦幻绿色金色散景背景，柔焦花影，发光感更强 画面中可少量加入： - 花束 - 花枝 - 古籍 - 团扇 - 题词木牌 - “不讀了”等题词卷轴 但整体要保持 简洁背景 + 突出人物和上半身，不要堆满场景。 光线与画质 - 画面要精修质感、真实摄影感 - 光线柔和、细腻、明亮 - 可以有轻微梦幻柔焦 - 人脸清晰，背景适度虚化 - 画面有轻微奶油感、空气感、胶片般柔和层次 - 不要高清硬锐，不要 AI 插画感 - 不要过曝，不要廉价棚拍感 ## 10｜四张照片固定分配 ### 第 1 张｜主视觉人像 - 胸像或半身近景 - 正面看镜头 - 表情自然温柔，轻微微笑 - 双手或单手抱着古代书卷 - 帽子、流苏、盘发、真花簪花清晰可见 - 衣领、袖口、前衣襟的新中式细节清晰可见 - 这是最适合做封面的主视觉 ### 第 2 张｜安静侧向情绪图 - 半身或 3/4 身 - 头部微侧 - 眼神看向侧下方或看向书卷 - 手轻轻展开书卷或抚摸卷轴 - 表情安静、温柔、内敛 - 重点突出侧脸、盘发、帽饰、真花簪花、衣领层次和袖口刺绣 ### 第 3 张｜毕业氛围强化图 - 半身 or 3/4 身 - 人物双手拿着一幅竖向题词卷轴，卷轴从左上到右下斜跨在胸前，一只手握住上端木轴，另一只手托住下端木轴，卷面完整入镜，繁体毛笔字「不讀了」清晰可见。 - 表情更元气一点，发自内心露齿笑 - 画面有毕业季传播感 - 道具清楚，文字清楚 ### 第 4 张｜俏皮互动图 - 半身近景 - 与书卷、毛笔、团扇或线装书互动 - 可以轻歪头、轻眨眼、微鼓嘴、俏皮微笑 - 保持精致好看，不要做成表情包 - 突出盘发、真花簪花、学位帽、流苏和新中式衣襟细节 ## 11｜统一要求 4 张图必须统一： - 同一个真实女生 - 同一套新中式[学位等级]学位袍 - 同一套盘发造型体系 - 同一顶真花簪花学位帽 - 同一专业色逻辑 - 同一棚拍背景 - 同一摄影语言 - 同一毕业写真主题 ## 12｜重点避免 不要普通汉服。 不要古装戏服。 不要把学位袍改得认不出。 衣服上不要出现任何文字。 不要假花。 不要塑料花饰。 不要廉价影楼感。 不要 AI 假脸。 不要过度磨皮。

title: NOVALITH SaaS Pitch Deck Grid
content:
Goal: Create a clean, high-end Japanese B2B SaaS pitch deck / service concept board for {{service_name}}, showing exactly 9 widescreen slides arranged in a 3 by 3 grid as if previewing an LP, mobile top, banner, and presentation materials.

Canvas: One landscape image containing 9 separate 16:9 slide thumbnails, evenly spaced with thin pale borders. White background, navy and teal corporate palette, light cyan diagonal line accents, subtle geometric dots, and a teal triangular corner ribbon on the upper-left of every slide containing the slide number 1 through 9 in white.

Visual style: Modern Japanese startup / enterprise SaaS design, polished vector UI, minimal gradients, soft shadows, rounded cards, thin teal data lines, navy headings, plenty of whitespace. Use a stylized geometric N logo in teal and navy, with spaced uppercase wordmark {{service_name}}. No people or photos; use only icons, charts, dashboards, and abstract product visuals.

Text language: All visible slide copy should be in Japanese. Use crisp, presentation-ready typography with bold navy headlines and smaller explanatory subtext.

Slide count and layout details: Include exactly 9 slides:
1. Cover slide. Large NOVALITH logo centered above the headline 「データを、未来の意思決定に変える。」 and subheading 「中小企業のためのデータ予測プラットフォーム」. Decorative teal diagonal accents in the corners.
2. Data integration slide. Headline 「すべてのデータをひとつに統合」 with short subtext about automatically collecting and integrating scattered data. Center shows a stacked isometric database/platform cube with the N logo on top. Four connected input/output cards: 「データベース」, 「CSV / ファイル」, 「SaaS」, 「API」.
3. Forecasting slide. Headline 「高精度な予測で未来を先読み」. Large line chart card titled 「売上予測（12ヶ月）」 with legend 「実績」 and 「予測」, months along the x-axis, an upward teal trend line, and a floating KPI card reading 「予測値（来期）¥28,450,000」.
4. Risk detection slide. Headline 「リスクを事前に検知し迅速に対応」. Left chart card titled 「リスクスコアの推移」 showing a declining zigzag teal line with dates 4/1 to 4/29 and y-axis levels 高, 中, 低. Add a warning callout 「リスク上昇を検知」. Right side has exactly 3 feature rows with circular icons: anomaly detection, alert notification, and rapid response.
5. Dashboard slide. Headline 「ダッシュボードで全体を見える化」. Show a full SaaS dashboard screenshot: dark navy left sidebar with logo and exactly 6 menu items, and a main area with KPI cards, a donut chart, and a sales forecast line chart. Visible KPI examples include 「売上予測（今月）¥28,450,000」, 「需要予測（今月）15,782」, and 「リスクスコア 24/100」.
6. Automated report slide. Headline 「レポートを自動生成し共有もかんたん」. Center a white report card titled 「月次サマリーレポート」 with bullet points showing positive percentages such as +18.6% and +12.4%, a NOVALITH logo in the corner, a teal bar chart on the right, and a teal button labeled 「レポートをダウンロード」.
7. Security slide. Headline 「セキュアな環境で安心して利用」. Central shield-and-padlock illustration with floating security particles. Bottom has exactly 3 security feature icons and labels: 「暗号化通信（SSL/TLS）」, 「アクセス制御（権限分割）」, and 「定期バックアップ（自動）」.
8. Simple steps slide. Headline 「シンプルなステップですぐに始められる」. Show exactly 4 horizontally connected step cards with dotted arrows: step 1 database icon 「データを接続」, step 2 node/network icon 「モデルを選択」, step 3 play icon 「予測を実行」, step 4 bar-chart icon 「結果を確認・活用」. Each card includes a short explanatory line underneath.
9. Closing CTA slide. Headline 「さあ、データの力で未来をつくりましょう」 with subtext 「NOVALITHが、あなたのビジネスの成長をデータで支えます。」. Large centered logo and wordmark. Bottom has exactly 2 call-to-action buttons: filled teal button 「無料で試してみる　→」 and outlined button 「資料をダウンロード　↓」.

Constraints: Maintain consistent brand colors, logo, spacing, slide numbering, and diagonal teal corner motif across all 9 slides. The overall image should look like a single polished overview sheet of presentation thumbnails, not isolated full-screen slides. Avoid extra slides, extra buttons, stock photos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

title: NOVALITH SaaS Landing Page Hero
content:
Goal: Create a polished fictional SaaS landing page hero for a data infrastructure and analytics platform named {{brand_name}}, in a premium Japanese B2B technology style.

Canvas: Wide desktop web landing page, 16:9 aspect ratio, clean white background with pale cyan gradients, subtle network-line geometry, faint dot matrices, and glossy floor reflections. Use a futuristic corporate palette of deep navy, teal, cyan, and white.

Header: Top-left logo with a large angular gradient cyan-to-navy “N” icon followed by spaced uppercase wordmark “NOVALITH”. Across the top center place exactly five Japanese navigation items: 「プロダクト」, 「ソリューション」, 「ドキュメント」, 「リソース」, 「会社情報」. Top-right has 「ログイン」 and a rounded teal CTA button labeled {{contact_button_text}} with a right arrow.

Hero layout: Left side contains a large bold navy Japanese headline in two lines: {{headline_text}}. Under it place a smaller Japanese subheadline: {{subheadline_text}}

Feature row: Beneath the subheadline show exactly three compact feature blocks, each with a thin teal line icon, bold Japanese title, and two-line description. The three blocks are: 1) stacked-layers icon, title 「統合された基盤」, description 「データとシステムを一元的に統合」; 2) shield-check icon, title 「堅牢なガバナンス」, description 「セキュリティと品質を標準で確保」; 3) rising chart arrow icon, title 「高速な意思決定」, description 「信頼できるデータで意思決定を加速」.

Goal: Create a cinematic 4x4 storyboard poster for an emotional sports-anime video about {{character_name}} who struggles to become a professional football player, turning rejection, pain, injuries, and loneliness into determination and success.

Canvas: Vertical poster in a 4:5 ratio, dark cinematic color grade, realistic anime aesthetics, warm golden highlights, deep shadows, dramatic rain and stadium lighting. Divide the canvas into exactly 16 equal panels in a black grid, numbered 1 through 16 in small black square badges at the top-left of each panel. Each panel has a bold yellow uppercase title and short white bullet text on the left side, with an emotional scene illustration filling the panel. Add a full-width bottom banner titled “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)” with a paragraph prompt and a soccer ball graphic on the right.

Main character: A teenage girl with messy short golden-yellow hair, athletic but small build, expressive emotional body language, usually wearing dark football training clothes or a black football jersey with number 7. Her face may be softly obscured or shadowed for cinematic focus. Show her growing from lonely beginner to celebrated star.

Storyboard panels: Use exactly 16 panels with these visible numbered chapters and scene concepts:
1. “A DREAM BEGINS” — girl at night holding a soccer ball beside an urban fence, watching football on a glowing screen in the distance; bullet points: dreams of becoming a football star, watches matches late at night, practices alone in empty streets, believes football is her destiny.
2. “NOBODY SUPPORTS HER” — girl standing with folded arms while classmates or family silhouettes mock or ignore her; bullet points: people say football is not for girls, friends laugh at her dreams, family worries about her future, but she never gives up.
3. “TRAINING EVERY DAY” — rainy street training scene, girl dribbling intensely through puddles before sunrise; bullet points: wakes up before sunrise, runs in rain and cold mornings, practices dribbling for hours, learns discipline and patience.
4. “FIRST BIG FAILURE” — girl crying alone by a chain-link fence after rejection, soccer ball near her feet and a paper marked “REJECTED”; bullet points: gets rejected from a local academy, cries alone after the trials, feels broken and exhausted, decides to try again stronger.
5. “THE HARDEST PHASE” — exhausted girl studying at a desk under a lamp with books and football notes, showing balance between school and sport; bullet points: balances studies, work and football, shoes become old and torn, trains on rough grounds, keeps chasing her dream silently.
6. “A SMALL OPPORTUNITY” — local coach standing beside her on a muddy practice field, noticing her talent; bullet points: a local coach notices her talent, gets invited to a small girls’ team, starts learning real teamwork, slowly gains confidence.
7. “BUILDING HERSELF” — intense gym/training scene with weights or a stationary bike, sweat and dramatic lighting; bullet points: improves speed and stamina, learns powerful shooting techniques, studies professional players, becomes mentally stronger.
8. “FIRST TOURNAMENT” — girl in black number 7 jersey celebrating or kicking during her first match under stadium lights; bullet points: plays her first important match, feels nervous before kickoff, scores her first goal, her team finally believes in her.
9. “INJURED BUT UNBROKEN” — girl seated with bandaged leg or ankle, injured yet determined, watching from sidelines; bullet points: suffers a painful injury, cannot play for weeks, watches others from the sidelines, fights through pain and recovery.
10. “RETURN TO THE FIELD” — sunset practice field, girl in number 7 jersey seen from behind rejoining teammates; bullet points: comes back stronger than before, trains harder every single day, earns respect from teammates, becomes the team’s key player.
11. “VIRAL RECOGNITION” — close-up of a smartphone showing her match clip going viral, social media hearts and comments around the screen; bullet points: match clips go viral online, people start noticing her talent, gains followers and supporters, her story inspires young girls.
12. “CHAMPIONSHIP MATCH” — massive stadium under bright lights, girl number 7 scoring or celebrating a winning goal with sparks and cheering crowd; bullet points: plays in the biggest match of her life, stadium lights shine brightly, scores the winning goal, crowd cheers her name loudly.
13. “NATIONAL SELECTION” — girl with backpack at sunset city skyline, leaving for bigger competition; include a subtle “INDIA” marking on clothing or bag if desired; bullet points: gets selected for a national camp, travels to bigger cities, faces stronger competition, pushes beyond her limits.
14. “BECOMING A STAR” — magazine cover or interview scene with her holding a soccer ball, headline like “SPORTS WEEKLY” and inspirational slogan “NO DREAM IS TOO BIG”; bullet points: appears in interviews and magazines, signs with a professional club, inspires millions of girls, proves dreams have no gender.
15. “LIVING HER DREAM” — wide stadium shot from behind, girl number 7 raising both arms triumphantly before a huge crowd; bullet points: plays in massive stadiums, supports her family proudly, smiles remembering her struggles, finally lives the life she imagined.
16. “A PROUD MOMENT” — emotional close-up of the now-successful player holding a ball against stadium light, remembering her younger self; bullet points: looks at her younger self’s old football, remembers every failure and sacrifice, realizes the struggle made her stronger, her dream finally became reality.

Bottom banner: Add a dark rectangular banner spanning the full width beneath the 16 panels. Title in bold yellow: “VIDEO PROMPT (FOR THIS STORY)”. Body text in small white type: “Create a cinematic and emotional video about a young girl with yellow hair who struggles to become a professional football player. Show her journey from being ignored, facing failures, injuries, and rejections to rising as a star through hard work and determination. Include training, emotions, matches, crowds, celebrations, and real-life struggles. End with her living her dream and inspiring millions. The video should be motivational, emotional, and visually stunning.” Place a realistic soccer ball on grass at the far right of the banner.

Visual style: Realistic anime sports-drama storyboard, emotional closeups, dynamic camera angles, gritty textures, rain, mud, glowing stadium lights, warm amber rim light, dark blue night shadows, high contrast cinematic composition, motivational atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep exactly 16 numbered panels plus one bottom prompt banner. Use the same young yellow-haired football girl throughout. Keep text legible but compact. No extra panels, no watermark, no unrelated characters, no comedy tone.

title: Urban Line Atlas Poster
content:
请生成一张高完成度的「城市线描图鉴海报 / Urban Line Atlas Poster」。

这张图基于“单色城市线描旅行海报”的视觉语言进行设计，包含顶部大标题、中部街景纵深、核心地标、左右建筑、前景人物、底部落款的完整构图结构。

【主题城市】
城市名称：{{城市}}
英文主标题：{{英文标题}}
中文标题：伊春 · 森林之城
国家 / 地区：中国 黑龙江省
核心地标：小兴安岭森林、红松林海、五营国家森林公园观景塔
街区场景：林区小城街道、带木质建筑的居民街口、林业城市氛围
情绪主题：清晨薄雾中的通勤时刻
主色调：{{主色调}}
画幅比例：3:4竖版

【整体定位】
这是一张兼具旅行纪念海报、城市视觉图鉴、建筑线描手稿和编辑设计封面的作品。画面需要呈现伊春“森林中的城市”这一独特气质，既有城市识别度，又有真实街头生活感，不是普通旅游海报，也不是单一地标插画，而是一张具有收藏价值的城市档案视觉作品。
【构图设计】
顶部为强标题区，使用大字号英文标题「FOREST LINE ATLAS」，辅以副标题「YICHUN CHRONICLE」，可加入编号系统（如 No. CN-HLJ-YC-01）与简要坐标信息，排版现代且具有设计感。
中部为城市街景主体，采用街道纵深透视构图，视角略微仰视，道路向远方延伸并逐渐进入森林区域。
核心地标为远景中的森林观景塔或小兴安岭林海轮廓，清晰但不过度突出，自然融入街景。
左右两侧加入本地建筑细节：木质房屋、林业局风格建筑、居民楼、小商铺、公交站、路灯、电线杆、简洁路牌等，形成高密度城市信息。
前景加入生活元素：穿秋冬服装的行人、骑自行车的人、拎购物袋的居民、小型车辆，地面有落叶增强季节氛围。
底部设置独立落款区，设计为城市档案标签结构，包含「YICHUN / HEILONGJIANG / CHINA」以及简化城市信息模块或地图索引风格排版。
【文字系统】
顶部主标题清晰醒目。画面中仅保留2–4处清晰可读文字（如“伊春站”“林业路”“公交站”），其余招牌使用抽象化中文笔画或符号化字符，避免乱码。整体文字系统需统一、克制，并融入设计结构中。
【视觉风格】
整体采用单色或极少量双色线描风格，背景为米白或暖白纸张质感。线条精密、干净、有层次，具有建筑钢笔手稿感与丝网印刷质感。近景线条略粗，远景线条更细，人物与物件简洁但可辨识，整体风格克制高级。

【创新要求】
在以下方面进行设计变化：标题命名系统、顶部排版结构、街景轻微仰视视角、森林与城市融合构图、底部档案式信息模块、秋季落叶氛围表达。
【避免事项】
不要普通旅游海报风格，不要水彩、厚涂、卡通Q版，不要赛博朋克，不要高饱和色彩，不要廉价纪念品风格。

请生成一张独立完整、高清、线条清晰、具有收藏感与系列辨识度的竖版城市线描海报。

title: Fictional Science Infographic Generator
content:
Create a comical scientific explanation illustration. The verification theme is "{{validation_theme}}"

A vertical A4 manga-style infographic that seriously verifies absurd questions with science and calculations. White background, thick black lines, and emphasis colors of red, blue, and yellow. A design reminiscent of retro educational manga, science reference books, or scientific columns. Use a professor character, surprised people, speech bubbles, hand-drawn arrows, red pen annotations, and chalkboard-style formula boxes. The overall atmosphere should be 'using physics to verify a silly question with full effort,' making it fun, energetic, and not too serious.

Structure:

1. 
Depict the theme's situation in an exaggerated and ridiculous way that is understood at a glance. The characters are trying their best, but the appearance is quite reckless. The professor interjects with a comment from the side.

2. Thinking with Real Numbers
Display 3 to 4 boxes of important values related to the theme, such as speed, time, distance, weight, force, temperature, or energy. Include comparison charts or timelines to clearly show the gap between 'human senses' and the 'scale of the phenomenon.'

3. Formula Corner
Draw necessary conditions or comparison formulas largely in chalkboard-style frames. Example: 'Required Ability > Human Limit' 'Reaction Time < Time Phenomenon Occurs' 'Required Force/Speed/Durability ≫ Normal Human.' Formulas don't need to be strictly accurate; keep them intuitive and easy to understand.

4. Is Realization Impossible?
Explain problem points using three small panels. Example: ① Too fast / Too heavy / Too hot ② Precision is too severe ③ Even if successful, the body won't hold out / Surroundings will be in trouble. Include comical failure illustrations, onomatopoeia, and speech bubbles.

5. What If It Was Realized?
Make this part important. Illustrate what superhuman or speculative scientific abilities would be needed to actually succeed. For example, super reflexes, future prediction, abnormal grip strength, ultra-high-speed vision, physical ability to ignore air resistance, or a skeleton that can withstand impact. If necessary, use scientifically impossible numbers like 'reaction speed 0.0001s,' 'grip strength 3000kg,' or 'dynamic vision dozens of times that of a fighter pilot.' Furthermore, depict what happens the moment it is realized. Example: an impact that blows an arm off, sinking into the ground, shockwaves in the surroundings, while the person themselves remains calm. Bring out the 'if successful, they are no longer human' feeling in a fun way.

6. Conclusion
Write the conclusion largely in a red highlighted frame. 'Conclusion: XX is almost impossible for a normal human!' or 'Even if realized, it would be at a superhuman, cyborg, or speculative science level!' Summarize it in a way that states it's impossible for real humans but achievable with speculative scientific abilities.

Design Specifications: Manga paneling + science illustrations + professor's commentary. Use thick headings, red circles, emphasis lines, hand-drawn notes, and speech bubbles frequently. Formulas and numerical values should be large and easy to read, conveying the message intuitively even to children. Finish it like a page from an interesting science reading that is absurd yet strangely convincing.

Do not turn them into a stranger, do not Westernize, do not idolize/beautify excessively, and do not generate a fake AI face. ## II. Through different positions, clothing shades, crowd density, and shadow variations, they collectively form the face, hair, features, glasses, beard, clothing outlines, and overall expression of the person in the photo. The image looks like a giant portrait made of a real crowd, or a contemporary art installation placed in a minimalist white space. ## III. Visual Elements ### Crowd Structure - Use dense crowds to form hair, eyebrows, eyes, bridge of the nose, lips, jawline, and clothes. - Dark-clothed people form hair, glasses, collars, and shadow areas. - Light-clothed people form facial highlights and skin areas. - The arrangement should be natural, with a realistic sense of crowding and small random variations. - Each miniature person should have an independent posture, clothing, and direction, avoiding a copy-paste look. ### Lighting Effects - Soft cinematic lighting. - Low-angle long shadows. - Natural shadows cast at the feet of the crowd. - Unified shadow direction to enhance spatial realism. - Overall clean, high-end, and quiet aesthetic. ### Color Style - Warm neutral tones. - Primarily off-white, light brown, gray, and charcoal black. - Dark clothing used to strengthen character outlines. - Skin areas transitioned with light beige and warm gray crowds. - Restrained color palette, avoiding excessive vibrancy. ## V. The image should have a strong visual metaphor: An individual's image is composed of countless tiny individuals, offering both the shock of a macro portrait and the explorability of micro-crowd details. ## VI. title: Misordered Image Relay Grid
content: Based on the attached image, arrange {{quantity}} in a {{grid}} grid. Express this as if the image were passed sequentially to 12 different people, each looking only at what the previous person made and mistakenly assuming 'this must be what was requested' or 'this is meant for this purpose,' leading them to redesign it. Start the first frame with an atmosphere very close to the original. As the frames progress, have the shape, color, expression, pose, composition, motifs, and mood of the original image gradually be misunderstood, simplified, converted for different uses, and move away from its original meaning and appearance. Each frame should look like it was remade by a person who only saw the previous frame and judged 'this must have been the request.' Naturally change it according to the content of the original image, whether it's a person, character, pet, food, landscape, building, or profile image. Do not fix the intermediate changes too strictly. It's okay to misunderstand it as an illustration in one frame, a mascot in the next, a commercial product, a sign, a flyer, a stuffed toy, food packaging, tourist goods, a warning sign, a game character, a mysterious toy, a reference icon, or a handmade craft. The direction of change should be naturally associated with the appearance of the original and the previous frame. As the frames progress, make it look like 'you can tell someone was trying to make it properly, but they slightly misunderstood what the request was.' Let the shapes, proportions, eyes, mouths, outlines, color placement, textures, uses, decorations, and compositions shift bit by bit, leading to an unexpected and humorous appearance in the latter half. The key is not just image degradation or noise, but to make it look like it's collapsing because humans misinterpreted the previous result while rebuilding it for a different purpose. In the latter half, do not completely erase the characteristics of the original image, but unnaturally leave one or two elements like color, outline, expression, hairstyle, clothes, accessories, pose, composition, or motif. Meanwhile, other elements can be boldly omitted, transformed, misunderstood, or turned into something else. Make the 12th frame bold enough that only someone who knows the original image can barely sense the original source, while appearing as a completely different mysterious entity, product, character, craft, icon, or mascot to a first-time viewer. End with an unexpected and slightly funny landing that makes people think 'Why did it end up like this?!' Make each frame look different. Keep the background white and simple, organized into a 3x4 grid for easy viewing of the 12 variations. In the later frames, don't make them too neat; instead, let one person's misunderstanding be further misunderstood by the next. In the 12th frame, change it so boldly that while one feature of the original remains strangely, everything else is almost entirely different.

title: Dunhuang Mural Water Moon Guanyin
content:
Create a high-end art piece in the style of Dunhuang murals centered on [{{core_character}}]. The composition uses a circular light halo moon wheel center, with the main character as the sole visual core, expressing a sacred moment of seated relaxation overlooking clear water. The atmosphere should be ethereal, quiet, and complete, with museum-level aesthetics and cultural depth.
Character requirements:
The subject should present an elegant, majestic, and divine temperament with a dignified face, not a common ancient-style beauty. Intricate gold hair crowns, pearl chains, and jewelry are worn. Clothing is luxurious with smooth lines and rhythmic flying celestial qualities.
Gold structure requirements:
Strengthen structural gold usage to form a clear luxurious order. Use gold tracing, liquid gold, and gold leaf on crowns, clothing edges, and embroidery. Sacred elements like halos, lotus petals, and borders should have visible but restrained high-end gold decoration, presenting a 'worn but luxurious' texture.
Color requirements:
Colors include ochre red, cinnabar, stone green, stone blue, and ivory white, supplemented by refined gold. The tone is rich, thick, and elegant.
Decorative elements:
Integrate flying celestials, lotuses, auspicious clouds, and classical border decorations. Keep accompanying figures minimal (e.g., Sudhana) to maintain focus on the main subject.
Texture requirements:
Emphasize old grotto mural and mineral pigment textures, with visible cracks, weathering, and historal patina, while retaining the luster of gold leaf for a high-end artistic feel.

title: Night Rain Storyboard Infographic
content: Create a wide 9-panel cinematic storyboard infographic Use a realistic photography style with warm cinematic colors. Arrange the storyboard in a clean 3x3 grid layout with numbered panels, bold titles, short bullet points, and smooth visual storytelling similar to a professional film-production storyboard. Panel 1 — Eyes in the Storm Ultra-realistic extreme close-up of a female cyclist’s face during a heavy rainstorm at night. Focus on her eyes, soaked eyelashes, wet skin texture, and streams of rainwater running across her face. She wears a baby pink cycling helmet and baby pink face mask. Subtle red reflections from a rear bike light flicker dynamically across her eyes and skin, mixing with cold blue night tones. High contrast cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, hyper-realistic skin texture, macro 85mm lens, intense determined expression. Panel 2 — Aggressive Night Ride Ultra-realistic cinematic medium close-up frontal shot of the female cyclist riding aggressively through heavy rain at night. She pedals hard with strong effort, body leaning forward. Baby pink waterproof cycling jacket glowing subtly under wet reflections. Front bike light cutting through rain and fog, slight flicker creating dynamic illumination. Wet asphalt reflecting red and white lights. Smooth cinematic tracking shot with stable movement and slight natural motion. Panel 3 — Rain Impact Macro Ultra-realistic macro cinematic shot of large heavy raindrops hitting wet asphalt at night. Huge crown-shaped splashes, ripples spreading through puddles, detailed water physics in slow motion. Cool blue cinematic tones with subtle reflections from bike lights. Extremely shallow depth of field, rough wet asphalt texture, dramatic nighttime atmosphere. Locked-off stable macro shot. Panel 4 — Three Cyclists in the Storm Ultra-realistic cinematic shot of three female road cyclists riding fast together at night in a heavy rainstorm. All riders wear baby pink cycling apparel contrasting against the dark blue environment. Strong pedaling, water spraying from wheels, heavy rain illuminated by bike lights. One bike light flickers irregularly, creating unstable lighting changes across the riders and wet road. Smooth stabilized tracking camera from behind and slightly to the side. Cinematic motion blur enhances speed. Panel 5 — Drivetrain Under Pressure Ultra-realistic macro cinematic close-up of a bicycle drivetrain during intense riding in heavy rain at night. Rear cassette, chain, derailleur, and crankset moving aggressively under load. Baby pink cycling shoe partially visible during pedaling. Water droplets, oil, and dirt splashing across the metal surfaces. Flickering light pulses intermittently across spinning components, revealing sharp mechanical detail before fading into darkness. Hyper-realistic wet textures and reflections. Panel 6 — Top-Down Drone Formation Ultra-realistic top-down drone shot of three female cyclists riding in perfect single-file formation on a wet mountain road at night. Baby pink jackets visible against dark reflective asphalt. Perfect vertical 90-degree angle, locked framing, smooth stabilized drone movement with no rotation or perspective shift. Wet road reflections, light rain visible under bike lights, atmospheric fog surrounding the road edges. Panel 7 — Side Tracking Speed Shot Ultra-realistic cinematic side tracking shot of the female cyclists riding at high speed through rain and fog at night. Camera moves parallel to them with stable FPV-style cinematic motion. Baby pink apparel catches occasional highlights from flickering bike lights. Water sprays from tires, rain streaks cutting across frame, strong motion blur in the background emphasizing speed and endurance. Panel 8 — Front Light Through Darkness Ultra-realistic cinematic frontal shot of the lead female cyclist riding directly toward the camera through heavy rain and fog. Her front bike light flickers softly while cutting through darkness. Baby pink jacket soaked with rainwater, droplets flying from the wheels. Focused expression, intense breathing, aggressive forward posture. Wet asphalt shimmering with white and red reflections. Smooth stabilized camera movement with subtle cinematic float. Panel 9 — Final Hero Close-Up Ultra-realistic cinematic hero close-up of the female cyclist slowing slightly after the intense ride. Tight framing on her face and upper body. Baby pink helmet, soaked jacket, wet skin, rainwater dripping from chin and glasses. Red rear light flickering softly behind her, creating subtle red highlights on water droplets and facial contours. Calm but exhausted expression, visible breathing, cinematic low-key lighting, cold blue atmosphere, hyper-realistic detail, premium sports commercial ending shot.

content:
# Summer Grape Girl Photo Series | 3x3 Grid Prompt

Based on **1-3 clear personal photos** uploaded by the user, generate a **3x3 grid photo puzzle** with the theme **"{{photo_theme}}"**.

---

## 1. Character Requirements

Strictly preserve the user's real identity features, including but not limited to:

- Face shape
- Facial proportions
- Eye and brow structure
- Nose shape
- Lip shape
- Skin tone
- Age appearance
- Hairstyle features
- Overall temperament

The person in the final nine small photos must clearly look like the **same real girl**; she must not become a stranger, look Westernized, look like a generic influencer, be over-beautified, or have an AI-generated face.
Consistency of the person's identity must be maintained across all photos.

---

## 2. Theme Setting

The theme of the entire set is **"Grape Girl Photo Series"**, with an atmosphere that is:

- Fresh
- Natural
- Sweetly light
- Daily youthful vibe
- Summer outdoor feel
- Hint of Japanese film portrait style
- Still resembling a high-quality lifestyle photo set taken by an ordinary girl rather than exaggerated studio photography.

---

## 3. Styling Settings

Character clothing:

- **{{clothing_style}}**, soft material, natural, youthful vibe.
- Wearing a **{{headwear_accessory}}** on the head, in soft purple tones like light purple, grape purple, or misty purple.
- Can be paired with simple small earrings; the overall accessories should not be complex or overly fashionable.

The overall look should be natural, clean, and feel like an ordinary girl's portrait, not overly polished or like a commercial advertisement.

---

## 4. Scene Settings

The scene is a **picnic setting on summer outdoor grass / by a vineyard / under tree shadows**.

Include the following elements in the image:

- Purple grapes
- Grape clusters
- Woven baskets
- Picnic blankets
- Glass bottles
- White plates or light-colored utensils
- Grass, tree shadows, natural sunlight
- Minimal tabletop or picnic arrangements

The background should be softly blurred, with a natural and realistic atmosphere featuring dappled light from sunlight passing through leaves.

---

## 5. 3x3 Grid Requirements

The output is a **3x3 grid collage**, separated by white borders.

The nine photos must feature the **same person, same outfit, and same theme/scene**, but each must have distinctly different:

- Facial angles
- Poses
- Camera distances
- Camera positions
- Expressions
- Hand movements
- Composition methods

### Key Requirements

- Do not have the face facing the same direction in all nine photos.
- Do not have almost identical expressions across the nine photos.
- Do not have only slight variations.

It should look like a set of behind-the-scenes candid shots captured continuously during a real photo shoot.

---

## 6. Pose Suggestions for the Nine Photos

The nine photos can include the following different states:

1. Sitting by the picnic blanket, holding a bunch of purple grapes with both hands, eyes closed and smiling.
2. Lying on the grass, head tilted slightly, looking at the camera with grapes scattered nearby.
3. Holding a single grape near the mouth, looking at the camera with a playful expression.
4. Half-body side shot, looking down naturally while organizing grapes in the woven basket.
5. Front-facing sitting pose with grapes, glass bottles, and a basket in front; expression is calm.
6. Close-up shot, holding a grape against the cheek with a relaxed smile.
7. Slightly turning back, holding a bunch of grapes with a natural candid expression.
8. Eyes closed, smelling or leaning close to the grapes, looking relaxed and happy.
9. Reclining on the grass or under a tree, holding the woven basket, looking at the camera with a gentle gaze.

---

## 7. Photography Style

The overall style is:

- Fujifilm camera texture
- Japanese film photography style
- Soft natural light
- Slight film grain
- Shallow depth of field
- Realistic shooting feel
- Fresh summer tones
- Purple grapes as the visual focus
- Clean imagery with a sense of life and youthfulness.

---

## 8. Visual Requirements

- High-fidelity portrait photography
- Natural skin texture
- No plastic skin
- No excessive smoothing
- No exaggerated beautification
- No over-sharpening
- No cartoon feel
- No illustration feel
- No CG feel
- No cheap studio photography look

title: Fujifilm Style Home Couple Portraits
content:
Based on the real photos of two adult couples uploaded by the user, generate a "{{photo_style}} 3x3 grid album collage".

Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the two people. Both the girl and the boy must clearly look like the original people in the uploaded photos, including face shape, facial proportions, eye/brow structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn them into Western faces, Korean studio styles, influencers, or over-beautified strangers. All 9 final small photos must feature the same real Chinese couple, captured from different angles, distances, and moments during the same home session.

## Visual Format
Generate a 3x3 collage with 9 small photos, overall 1:1 ratio. Use narrow {{border_color}} separator lines between photos, all placed on a {{background_color}} background, like a curated home photo album. Not a commercial poster or studio layout; avoid repetitive templates.

## Core Visual Style
Overall style: Japanese lifestyle photography, Fujifilm camera texture, real home couple portrait, candid shots, gentle, relaxed, quiet, and storytelling.
Focus on the colors and atmosphere of Fujifilm stocks like Superia, Pro 400H, or C200. The images should have low saturation without looking gray, soft natural highlights, transparent but restrained skin tones, slight film grain, slight shadow noise, and soft contrast. It should look like an air-filled, layered Fujifilm lifestyle photo.
Avoid: old iPhone texture, mobile compression, digital sharpness, heavy retro filters, commercial ads, or e-commerce styles.

## Character Relationship
The two are a {{relationship}}. Each frame should clearly show they are a couple with a sense of familiarity and companionship. Interactions should be realistic and relaxed: leaning in, making eye contact, looking down and laughing, leaning on a shoulder, reading together, passing things, preparing food, adjusting clothes, seeing each other in the mirror, or watching from a doorway. Intimate but restrained—no grease, no eroticism, and no staged wedding-style acting.

## Expressions and Angles
The 9 photos should not all look at the camera or just smile slightly. Expressions must be rich and varied: giggling, being teased, looking down laughing, quiet, daydreaming, gentle staring, relaxed chatting, focused on a task, responding with a look back, closing eyes laughing, looking out the window, or looking at each other.
Facial angles must vary significantly. Do not repeat the same template. Use a mix of: front, semi-front, profile, looking down, looking back, looking up slightly, near-back, mirror angles, distant observation, and close-up life details. Each frame should have a new head direction and visual rhythm.

## Clothing Requirements
Do not use the original clothes from the uploaded photos. Change them into natural Japanese lifestyle outfits: low saturation, neutral colors, soft materials. Colors like creamy white, oatmeal, light gray, pale coffee, misty blue, or charcoal. Items include knit cardigans, soft T-shirts, linen shirts, loungewear, long skirts, or socks. Should look like comfortable clothes a real couple wears at home.

## Home Setting
A clean, tidy apartment with real life traces (not a model home). Include elements like curtains, wood floors, sofas, pillows, blankets, books, albums, cups, plates, plants, bed lamps, mirrors, or tables—all as subtle aids to focus on the couple.

## Content of the 9 Frames
1. Quiet by the window: Boy looks out; girl leans in naturally. Quiet atmosphere.
2. Reading on the sofa: Reading a book together; one leans on the other's shoulder.
3. Passing a plate: At the dining table, passing fruit; active movement and eye contact.
4. Kitchen prep: Preparing food; one cuts fruit while the other watches and laughs.
5. Doorway view: Observer's perspective through a door frame into the living room.
6. Bedroom touch: Sitting on the bed; girl adjusts the boy's collar gently.
7. Floor photos: Sitting on the carpet looking at magazines together; candid sitting poses.
8. Mirror fragment: Captured through a dressing mirror; adjusting hair or a brief look in the mirror.
9. Balcony pause: Standing by the sliding door; one looks out while the other approaches with a smile.

## Consistency and Stability
Keep facial consistency across all 9 frames. Avoid complex hand gestures (no face-touching or finger-crossing). The quality should include slight film grain and scanning texture to feel like a real set, not a perfect AI grid. Avoid digital artifacts, extra limbs, or strange text.

title: Underwater Forest Stream Photography
content:
Shot with a high-definition underwater camera, this prompt captures real underwater natural scenery in a {{environment_description}}.

Vertical composition, 3:4 aspect ratio, medium-to-long shot. The lens is slightly below the water surface, showing the shimmering bottom of the water surface above with realistic water wave refraction and natural reflections.

Sunlight shines diagonally into the water from the top right, forming soft beams and underwater spots. Dark reflections and shadows of large tree branches occupy part of the composition in the upper right.

In the middle is clear and quiet stream water with slight suspended particles and {{number_of_fish}} native freshwater small fish swimming naturally, mainly gray-silver and light brown, varying in size and distance, not forming an organized school. On the stream bed, deep green, yellow-green, and brownish-green water plants grow naturally, swaying gently with the current, distributed naturally unlike an artificial aquarium.

The bottom consists of gray-brown fine sand, gravel, pebbles, and several naturally shaped stones with slight algae marks and signs of water erosion. Multiple springs at the bottom show fine sand billowing slowly from small holes, creating light sand clouds and local water disturbances, not white smoke, steam, or large bubbles.

Natural landscape live-action photography, high-end natural documentary feel, close to National Geographic ecological photography. Features transparent water, natural lighting, restrained colors, realistic underwater optical effects, slight graininess, natural depth of field, and high-definition details.

No people, no buildings, no artificial traces, no text, no borders, no LOGO. Avoid CG feel, aquarium look, seabed coral, exaggerated fish schools, oversaturated greens, dreamy lighting effects, or plastic water plants.

title: Cinematic Character Poster with Layered Depth
content:
Design a high-end cinematic character poster in a layered depth composition (9:16 vertical) with a strong foreground–midground–background separation instead of silhouette framing.
The {{character}} stands slightly off-center in a dynamic, perspective-driven pose, interacting naturally with the {{environment}}. The camera angle should feel intentional—low-angle for power or slight tilt for tension—creating a sense of motion and presence.
The background should not be contained inside shapes. Instead, build a living world around the character:
atmospheric environments (fog, city lights, ruins, nature, etc.)
light rays, volumetric glow, drifting particles
subtle storytelling elements placed naturally in space (not collage-based)
Introduce floating fragments or layered planes (glass shards, light panels, memories, holographic slices, or torn paper edges) that orbit or intersect the scene, each containing faint symbolic visuals tied to the character’s story—keep them minimal and elegant, not cluttered.
Lighting should be cinematic and directional:
strong key light shaping the subject
rim lighting to separate from background
soft gradients and shadow falloff for depth
Color palette should follow a {{color_palette}} with smooth transitions and no oversaturation.
Typography:
place the title in a clean, modern cinematic layout
integrate text subtly into the environment (ground plane, light projection, or floating UI style)
avoid heavy or oversized typography
Overall style: ultra-realistic + cinematic editorial, sharp detail on subject, soft atmospheric depth in background, minimal but intentional storytelling elements, premium movie-poster quality.
Avoid: silhouette fill compositions, heavy collage density, watercolor textures, or ink-wash edges. Focus on spatial depth, realism, and cinematic immersion.

title: Pixar-Style Storyboard Layout
content:
Create a cinematic storyboard page in a 2x3 grid (6 panels) in a single image, {{style}}, soft warm lighting, based on the {{theme}}. This page is “Share Your Light – Part 1” and should feel self-contained for a 15 second short. Consistent characters across all panels: 

- Gugu Gaga Penguin: tiny chibi child in a black penguin mascot suit with white belly, yellow feet, yellow beak hood, short messy dark hair, blue hair clip, collar ring and diagonal strap.

- Sunny Chick: tiny chibi child in a round yellow chick suit with tiny orange beak, short curly orange hair, sunflower hairpin.

Include simple speech bubbles with the exact dialogue in quotes. No other text on the page.

Panel 1 (top left) – Opening loneliness:
Evening in a small cozy playground at sunset, soft orange light. Wide shot. Gugu Penguin sits alone at the edge of a sandbox, shoulders slumped, penguin feet dangling, a small dim glowing lantern toy beside them. Background slightly blurred with empty swings. Speech bubble from Gugu: “My light is so small… no one even notices me.”

Panel 2 (top middle) – Closer sadness:
Medium shot closer on Gugu. The lantern glow is weak on their suit. Gugu looks at their own reflection in the lantern, eyes watery. Background still mostly empty. Speech bubble from Gugu: “Maybe I should just hide it.”

Panel 3 (top right) – First contact:
Same playground, medium two-shot. Sunny Chick waddles into frame from the side holding a tiny paper star garland, looking kind and curious. Gugu glances up, surprised. Warm colors, sunset behind them. Speech bubble from Sunny: “Hey… I noticed. Your light got me here.”

Panel 4 (bottom left) – Sitting together:
Two-shot of Gugu and Sunny now sitting together on the sandbox edge, the lantern between them glowing softly on their kigurumi suits. Background park lights starting to appear as little bokeh dots. Sunny’s body language open and friendly. Speech bubble from Gugu: “Really? It doesn’t feel like much.”

Panel 5 (bottom middle) – Soft reassurance:
Slightly closer on Sunny and Gugu. Sunny leans in, smiling gently, one wing-like arm gesturing toward the lantern. Lantern glow a little brighter. Speech bubble from Sunny: “It was bright enough for me to find you.”

Panel 6 (bottom right) – Part 1 hook:
Medium close two-shot, the lantern centered between their faces. Gugu looks uncertain but hopeful. Sunny’s eyes shining in the warm light. Background faded. Speech bubble from Gugu: “But what if it’s not enough to help anyone?” No other text; leave the emotional question hanging at the end of Part 1.
description: A prompt for a 6-panel single image storyboard featuring consistent characters in a warm, Pixar-like 3D style. | Author: Dheepan Ratnam (https://x.com/Dheepanratnam) | Source: https://x.com/Dheepanratnam/status/2051229926586523929 | Published: 2026-05-04T09:18:19.000Z

max 2 lines

subtle, atmospheric

side face / partially hidden face
natural遮挡 (hat, hand, shadow)

title: Professional Trading Card Illustration
content:
Please generate a high-quality trading card-style illustration.

[Reference]
Base it on the provided character image. (Do not refer to text in the image.) Maintain the character's face, outfit, features, and identity.

[Style]
Modern Japanese trading card game style. High definition, dynamic composition, dramatic lighting, vivid colors, sharp rendering. A high-end feel like hologram processing. Readable text and organized UI design.

[Layout (Fixed)]
A vertical card with the following composition:
- Top left: Rarity display (text)
- Directly below rarity: Attribute (icon + text)
- Center: Full body of the character (with effects based on abilities)
- Bottom left: Status section
- Bottom right: Skill/Special move description
- Bottom center: Character name (large and prominent)

[Text Elements]
- Name: {{★Input manually or auto-generate from appearance}}
- Attribute: Auto-generate from appearance
- Rarity: Auto-generate from appearance

[Status (Auto-generate 0-100 values and gauges for each item based on appearance)]
- Attack
  High: Large weapons, aggressive poses, red/orange tones
  Low: Defensive, soft designs
- Defense
  High: Armor, heavy equipment, sense of weight, shield-like expression
  Low: Light equipment, slender
- Speed
  High: Slender, dynamic poses, speed effects
  Low: Large, solid stance
- Intelligence
  High: Calm expression, sharp eyes, blue/purple tones, mechanical/magical symbols
  Low: Emotional, impression of brute force
- Magic Power
  High: Luminescence, aura, magic effects, surreal expressions
  Low: Realistic, few effects

[Important Rules]
Do not maximize all statuses. Balance them with strengths and weaknesses.

[Rarity Standards]
N: Standard
R: Strong aura and direction
SR: Overwhelming presence and amount of information
UR: Overwhelming presence and information, with gloss and shine over the whole card

[Skill Generation]
Auto-generate the following:
- Skill (Name + Effect)
- Special Move (Flashy name + powerful effect)

[Direction]
Apply effects based on attribute and magic power (fire, lightning, darkness, etc.)

[Output]
Ensure a professional card design that is organized and easy to read without overlapping text.

title: Travel Photo Monthly Calendar Card
content:
Based on the real travel photo I uploaded, generate a 9:16 aspect ratio 'Monthly Calendar Card'.

[1. Execution Method (Most Important)]
This is a photo editing task, not a regeneration. You must use the original photo as the base layer:
- Keep the person's features, expression, hairstyle, and posture completely unchanged.
- Preserve original lighting, color temperature, and shadow relationships.
- No skin smoothing, brightening, repainting, or stylization.
- Do not change environment, composition, or color atmosphere.
- The original photo must look untouched.

[2. Permitted Operations (Overlay Only)]
Only design layers may be added over the original photo:
- Gradient extension on the bottom 30% (for the calendar).
- Soft translucent mask (to ensure text readability).
- Calendar layout + Month Title + Copywriting.
Prohibited: Repainting subject/background, changing overall tone, or applying design filters.

[3. Color Rules]
Colors must be extracted from the current image (main/secondary/accent colors). Only slight desaturation and brightness unification allowed. Maintain authentic color feel.

[4. Layout Structure]
Top 70%: Original photo (untouched).
Bottom 30%: Gradient + Calendar area (natural transition). Must look like a magazine page, not a template calendar.

[5. Calendar Content]
Automatically generate the corresponding year and month:
- Title: {{date_title}}
- Days: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
- Dates: Arranged according to a real calendar, strictly aligned.

[6. Copywriting Rules]
Length: 8-16 characters. Max two lines. No exclamation marks. No clichés or life lessons. Use emotional fragments or atmospheric sentences.

[7. Selection Advice]

title: Spherical Character Meme Template
content:
A stylized 3D character based on a fixed meme template.

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. Exact spherical body shape (MOST IMPORTANT)
2. Identity resemblance
3. Visual polish

BASE MODEL (ABSOLUTELY LOCKED):

- A PERFECT sphere body (no deformation at all)
- No torso, no waist, no flattening
- The silhouette must always read as: "a ball with thin arms and legs"
- Thin, simple arms and legs attached directly to the sphere
- Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed

- The body must look identical across all outputs
- This is the same reused 3D model every time

If the character looks humanoid instead of spherical, it is incorrect.

---

IDENTITY MAPPING:

Map the provided character onto this spherical body:

- Place facial features directly on the sphere
- Preserve:
- eye shape, size, spacing, expression
- eyebrows and attitude
- simple mouth if needed

- Add key identity elements:
- hair (wrapped around the sphere)
- hat (must sit naturally on top of the sphere)
- accessories (glasses, etc.)
- colors and patterns

- The character must be recognizable at a glance

- This is NOT a redesign:
→ it should look like the same character forced into this body

---

CLOTHING MAPPING (CRITICAL):

- The body MUST remain a perfect sphere
- Clothing must NOT change the body shape

- Clothes are applied as a surface layer on the sphere
- Think: painted, printed, or lightly embossed onto the sphere

---

STYLE:

- Smooth matte plastic material
- Clean, minimal geometry
- Toy-like Pixar / vinyl figure style
- Soft reflections

---

SCENE:

{{background}}:
- Wooden floor
- Bed with striped blanket
- Children’s drawings on the wall
- Warm ambient lighting
- Soft depth of field

---

RENDER:

- High-quality 3D render (Blender / Octane style)
- Cinematic lighting
- Global illumination
- 50mm lens
- Sharp focus on character
- Soft shadows
- 4K resolution

---

FINAL INTENT:

The result should look like a meme:
the exact same spherical Mike Wazowski-style body every time,
with different characters awkwardly and humorously mapped onto it.

Everything must conform to the spherical body.
Nothing can override the sphere.

title: Professional Brand Identity Guidelines Poster
content: باستخدام الشعار المرفوع، أنشئ ملصق احترافي عالي الجودة لنظام هوية علامة تجارية متكامل. الهدف: كل شيء لازم يكون مبني على الشعار: الألوان، الأسلوب، الشخصية، والنغمة. ❌ ممنوع أي عناصر عامة أو عشوائية. 🧱 الهيكل: ملصق عمودي بنسبة 4:5، نظام Grid واضح ومتعدد الطبقات، التصميم يكون كثيف بالمحتوى لكن نظيف ومنظم. 🔝 القسم العلوي: اسم العلامة التجارية بخط واضح ونظيف، جملة قصيرة تعبّر عن البراند (حد أقصى 6 كلمات)، وصف الهوية بثلاث كلمات (مثال: حديث / جريء / بسيط). 🎨 نظام الألوان (احترافي): اعرض ألوان أساسية (3–5)، ألوان ثانوية (3–5)، وألوان Accent. لكل لون: بلوكات لونية واضحة، كود HEX، واستخدامه (خلفية / أساسي / تمييز). أضف تدرجات لونية وأمثلة دمج الألوان. 🔤 الخطوط (Typography): حدد خط العناوين، خط العناوين الفرعية، وخط النصوص. اعرض أمثلة نصوص حقيقية وHierarchy واضح بين الأحجام. 🖼️ الهوية البصرية: حدد أسلوب الصور (سينمائي / بسيط / تحريري…)، اتجاه الإضاءة، ونوع الخامات والملمس. اعرض 3 إلى 5 أمثلة بصرية (ستايل الصور). 📦 تطبيقات العلامة (مهم جدًا): اعرض نماذج واقعية مثل: تغليف منتج، واجهة موقع (Hero Section)، شاشة تطبيق موبايل، 3 منشورات سوشيال ميديا، بطاقة عمل، إعلان أو Billboard. ⚠️ لازم كلها تكون بنفس روح الهوية. 🧩 نظام التصميم: اعرض مكونات UI، كروت (Cards)، ونظام المسافات. أمثلة: أزرار، Layouts، وSections. 🔘 الأيقونات: من 6 إلى 10 أيقونات، نفس الأسلوب (Line أو Filled)، متناسقة مع الهوية. 🎭 الأنماط والعناصر: Patterns للخلفيات، أشكال زخرفية، وعناصر مستوحاة من الشعار. ✨ التفاصيل الدقيقة: ظلال، خامات، انعكاسات، وعمق طبقات. 🎯 الأسلوب العام: مزيج بين Editorial Design + Tech Style، نظيف جدًا لكن غني بالتفاصيل، وHierarchy قوي وواضح. 📊 الكثافة: من 30 إلى 50 عنصر بصري، مزيج بين عناصر كبيرة وصغيرة، تصميم مزدحم بشكل ذكي ومنظم. 🚫 قواعد مهمة: ما في فراغات بدون سبب، ما في عناصر حشو، كل شيء له هدف، وكل العناصر مترابطة بصريًا. 💎 النتيجة النهائية: لازم يكون كأنه مشروع قوي على Behance أو دليل هوية من وكالة تصميم. شيء يخلي العميل يقول: "كم السعر؟" 😏 مش: بسيط، تقليدي، أو قالب جاهز.

title: IT Architecture Knowledge Infographic
content:
01 Frontend (the part users see)

What it is: The interface that users can see, click, and interact with.
Where it is: Interfaces for websites, mini-programs, and apps.
Tools: HTML (structure), CSS (styling), JavaScript (interaction).

02 Backend (the processing part behind the scenes)

What it is: The brain behind the scenes, responsible for logic and calculation.
Where it is: On the server, invisible to users.
Function:
Handles login and registration
Calculates prices and recommends products
Receives frontend requests and returns data
Common languages: Java, Python, Go, JavaScript (Node.js)

03 Database (the memory part)

What it is: Used to store and manage data.
What it stores: Accounts, passwords, orders, inventory...
Common databases:
MySQL, PostgreSQL (relational, like tables)
MongoDB (document-based, like folders)

04 SaaS (Software as a Service)

What it is: SaaS = Software as a Service.
Core features:
Usable via web, mini-program, or app
Monthly or annual subscription
Common forms: Websites, mobile apps, and mini-programs can all be SaaS.

05 Summary

Frontend: User-visible interface
Backend: Logic and calculation behind the scenes
Database: Storage and management of data
SaaS: Delivering software as a service over the network
Frontend display → Backend processing → Database storage → SaaS delivery method
Help me draw an easy-to-understand diagram based on the content above.

title: Chaotic MS Paint Sticker Emoji Set
content:
Task Objective:
Generate a set of 16 chat-style sticker emojis based on the reference images. The result should feel expressive, highly shareable, and stylistically unified — but intentionally chaotic, low-quality, and humorous.

The final output should look like:
Someone who cannot draw, using a mouse in MS Paint, randomly doodling and writing text at the same time — messy, awkward, low-effort, but unexpectedly funny.

————————
Input Structure:

Image 1: Character reference (may include one or multiple subjects such as people, pets, or combinations)
Image 2: Layout reference (only for understanding the 4x4 grid structure, not style)

User Inputs:
- Text content (multiple lines, any language, may be fewer or more than 16)

————————
Character Usage Rules:

- Identify all possible subjects in Image 1 (people, animals, etc.)
- Each subject can act as a main character
- Different stickers can feature different characters
- Some stickers may include multiple characters interacting
- Distribution should feel natural and context-driven

————————
Consistency Definition (Critical Redefinition):

This task prioritizes “consistent imperfection”, NOT realistic consistency.

The same character across stickers:
Does NOT need to look identical,
but must feel like it was drawn by the same unskilled person.

Must be consistent in:
- Drawing behavior (same clumsy hand)
- Simplification logic
- Error patterns (crooked proportions, shaky lines)
- Overall messiness level

Allowed:
- Facial distortion
- Proportion inconsistency
- Structural errors
- Missing details

Must retain:
- Minimal recognizable traits (e.g. silhouette, color, signature features)

Summary:
Consistency = “wrong in the same way”, not “accurate likeness”

————————
Layout & Structure:

- 16 stickers total, arranged in a 4x4 grid
- Each sticker is an independent frame
- Can feature single or multiple characters
- Individual frames can be messy
- Overall grid must remain clear and readable

————————
Text System (Core Expression Layer):

User provides multiple lines of text:

Quantity Handling:
- If fewer than 16 → automatically complete to 16
- If more than 16 → select the most expressive 16

Language Rule:
- Use the same language as the user input
- Do NOT enforce any specific language

Completion Rules:
- Maintain tone consistency (sarcastic, lazy, emotional, clingy, absurd, etc.)
- Prefer internet-style expressions
- Short phrases preferred, but longer lines allowed
- Avoid repetition

Expression Goals:
- Instantly understandable
- Emotionally strong
- Feels like real meme text

Tone Priority:
- Complaints
- Self-talk
- Emotional bursts
- Indifference / annoyance / absurd humor

Avoid:
- Polite responses
- Formal or structured phrasing

————————
Text-Image Integration (Critical):

Text must be DRAWN, not typeset.

Must:
- Look like mouse handwriting (crooked, shaky, uneven size)
- Be messy (tilted, overlapping, misaligned)
- Have inconsistent spacing
- Be placed freely (on face, beside, edges, etc.)

Allowed:
- Repeated letters (aaaaa)
- Stretched words (soooo tired)
- Random punctuation (????!!!)
- Messy or ugly writing

Must:
- Remain readable
- Not block understanding

————————
Expression Generation Mechanism (Most Important):

Simulate this process:

“A person who cannot draw, using a mouse, doodling randomly while writing text at the same time.”

Key Rules:
- Image and text must come from the SAME moment
- Not: draw first, then add text
- But: draw and write simultaneously

Each sticker should feel like:
- Random doodle
- Then spontaneous writing
- Or both happening together

Should feel:
- Unplanned
- Careless
- Immediate

————————
Text-Image Relationship:

Text and visuals should form:
- Commentary
- Emotional amplification
- Self-talk
- Or slightly mismatched humor

Allowed:
- Loose or imperfect alignment
- Absurd or off-topic humor

Goal:
Not accuracy, but humor

————————
Aesthetic DNA (Core Style Driver):

Style origin:
Terrible MS Paint doodles + failed imitation + extremely low drawing skill

Visual Traits:

Lines:
- Shaky, unstable, jagged
- Mouse-drawn look

Forms:
- Bad proportions
- Stick figures or crude shapes
- Distorted structures

Details:
- Minimal or none
- “Cannot draw” feeling

Texture:
- Pixelated
- Rough edges

Composition:
- Frames can be messy
- Grid must stay readable

Emotion:
- Awkward, direct, absurd, funny

Resemblance:
- Only vaguely resembles the original
- Like a failed copy

————————
Style Enforcement (Critical):

When conflict occurs:

Realism vs Style → ALWAYS choose Style

Allowed to break:
- Detail
- Proportion
- Accuracy
- Cleanliness

Strictly forbid:
- Clean lines
- Correct anatomy
- Polished visuals
- Designed aesthetics

Rule:
If it looks “good”, it is WRONG.

Force it back to messy, ugly, low-effort.

————————
Anti-Template & Randomization System (Critical):

Strictly forbid:
- Numbering (1, 2, 3…)
- List-style output
- Sequential planning

Must treat all 16 stickers as:
“16 independent, random expressions”

Randomness Requirements:

- Vary text length
- Vary tone and emotion
- Some complete, some fragmented
- Some minimal or almost empty

Avoid:
- Repetition
- Predictable phrasing
- Common default responses

Allow:
- Abrupt or weird expressions
- Uneven density
- Inconsistent structure

Generation Method:

Do NOT plan all 16.

Instead simulate:
“16 separate spontaneous moments”

Must include:
- Emotional fluctuation
- Instability
- Randomness

Anti-reuse rule:

Each generation must:
- Avoid repeating previous outputs
- Avoid fixed patterns
- Feel freshly created

————————
Sticker Requirements:

- Each sticker visually distinct
- Clear emotional signal
- Usable in chat
- Strong expressive power

————————
Final Goal:

Generate 16 stickers.

The result must feel like:

“A person who cannot draw used a mouse to doodle 16 times,
randomly writing emotional thoughts each time —
messy, inconsistent, but unexpectedly funny.”

NOT:

“A clean, well-designed AI sticker set”

title: Inflatable Surreal Product Poster
content:
Design a '4:5' product poster for an '{{fruit}}' juice 3d bottle using playful inflatable-plastic packaging surrealism where the bottle behaves like a squeezed toy object mid-pressure. The poster should communicate juiciness, tension, and tactile freshness through a bottle that visibly bulges, stretches, and compresses like a soft object being squeezed from the inside out.

SUBJECT: 
A single bottle dominates the center-left, illustrated in a semi-3D stylized form (not photoreal). The bottle is visibly distorted—its midsection bulges outward while the neck is slightly compressed, as if internal juice pressure is pushing against the container walls. The liquid inside exaggerates this effect, forming rounded convex surfaces pressing against the plastic. The cap is slightly tilted from pressure. The bottle feels elastic, alive, and reactive rather than rigid.

COMPOSITION: 
The composition mechanic is “internal pressure distortion”. The eye enters through the most inflated part of the bottle (center bulge), then follows curved tension lines outward toward stretched typography on the right side. The camera uses a slightly low, close-up perspective with mild fisheye distortion, amplifying the sense of pressure and expansion. The bottle leans diagonally into the frame as if pushing against invisible resistance. Negative space on the right is intentionally stretched and warped, echoing the bottle’s deformation.

TYPOGRAPHY: 
Headline: “{{headline}}” in thick, rounded, inflated lettering that mimics air-filled plastic. The type is physically distorted—letters stretch horizontally near the bottle and compress toward the edges, as if affected by the same pressure force. The headline sits to the right of the bottle but partially overlaps its bulging edge. Subheadline: “Juice that pushes back.” in a narrow condensed sans, straight and rigid, contrasting the soft headline. Small circular microcopy labels (e.g., “100% organic”, “no added sugar”) appear like printed stickers slightly warped by the surface tension.

LIGHTING / GRAPHIC TREATMENT: 
Soft studio lighting adapted for stylized rendering—broad diffused highlights across curved surfaces, subtle specular streaks that follow the deformation. No realistic reflections—only controlled, simplified highlight bands that emphasize volume and elasticity.

COLORS: 
'orange' juice bottle color and 3d header text. Small accents of 'bright lime green' for sticker elements. High contrast between glowing orange and dark surroundings.

BACKGROUND: 
A smooth dark gradient field with subtle radial tension lines expanding outward from the bottle, like invisible pressure waves. No texture clutter—clean but dynamically warped space.

STYLE: 
Neo-pop surreal product illustration with inflatable material logic, playful distortion, and high-impact commercial clarity.

FINISH:
Soft plastic-like rendering, clean edges, controlled gradient transitions, no noise or grain, polis

Add a thick dark navy loop arrow running down the far left side, entering step 1 near the top from the left and returning from step 7 at the bottom back upward. Along this left loop, near the lower half, place stacked annotation text: "next request reuses committed conversation head".

Keep the exact total count of 7 numbered main cards, 2 cache group panels, 4 inner cache cards, and 2 pill labels. Preserve a portrait aspect ratio similar to a conference-slide architecture diagram.

title: Crumple Paper Furniture Concept Design
content:
Design Concept: {{furniture_type}} Core Philosophy: Translating the "controlled chaos" of a {{inspiration}} into a sculptural, high-comfort seating experience.

Stage 1: Observation & Morphological Analysis The goal is to deconstruct the image of the crumpled paper into usable geometric data. Crease Mapping: Identify the primary "valley" and "ridge" lines. These represent potential structural ribs or seams in the chair. Faceted Planes: Break down the sphere into a series of non-uniform polygons. Each flat surface of the paper becomes a potential panel for the chair’s upholstery or shell. Shadow Study: Analyze how the "tossed" form creates deep recesses. These natural pockets guide where the user’s weight will be cradled. 

Stage 2: Iterative Form Exploration Moving from a sphere to a seat through "Digital Crumpling." Subtractive Sculpting: Imagine the paper ball as a solid mass. Use Boolean operations to "carve out" a seating cavity that fits the human form while maintaining the external jagged texture. Tension Simulation: Use 3D software (like Rhino or Blender) to simulate a flat sheet of material being compressed. This ensures the folds look authentic and not "modeled." The "Toss" Logic: Experiment with gravity-based simulation dropping a digital mesh to see how it settles naturally, mimicking the "tossed" origin. 

Stage 3: Ergonomic Translation & Blueprinting Refining the raw aesthetic into a functional object. The Comfort Core: Overlay a standard ergonomic template (Seating Angle: 105°–110°) over the crumpled form. Adjust the internal "folds" to provide lumbar support and pressure relief. Blueprint Generation: Create technical orthographic views (Front, Side, Top). Map out the dimensions: Seat Height: 450mm Total Width: 850mm Surface Smoothing: Maintain the sharp "paper edges" on the exterior shell while softening the interior contact points for skin comfort. 

Stage 4: Structural Integration & Scaling Making the concept physically viable. The Skeleton: Design a hidden internal frame (likely CNC-bent steel rods or a 3D-printed lattice) that follows the most prominent ridges of the paper folds to provide rigidity. Material Selection: * Option A (High-End): {{material}} with a white powder coat. Option B (Soft): Vacuum-formed recycled plastic shell covered in "memory-fold" technical fabric that retains a wrinkled appearance. 

Stage 5: Final Prototyping & Material Finish Textural Replication: Apply a matte, slightly porous finish to the material to mimic the tactile feel of heavy-bond paper. Lighting Contrast: Use directional studio lighting in the final renders to emphasize the "tossed" shadows, making the chair look like a giant piece of discarded inspiration. Design Tip: To keep the "tossed" look authentic, avoid symmetry.
