title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
content:
Couple Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet (Street Setting, Reference Face)
[VISUAL STYLE]
Monochrome grayscale composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered dancing couple. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean, high-contrast lighting with soft shadows to clearly define body movement, posture, and interaction between both dancers.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16, showing a continuous partnered dance progression.
[CHARACTERS]
Female dancer:
Must match the provided reference image exactly (same face, features, skin tone, proportions)
Natural makeup, soft elegant expression
Consistent identity across all 16 panels
Male dancer:
Young adult male with clean, well-groomed appearance
Neutral, complementary features (not overpowering the female subject)
Proportional, realistic build
[WARDROBE]
Female outfit (IMPORTANT – keep consistent with reference sheet):
Fitted crop top (modest, clean neckline, same style as previous sheet)
High-waisted straight/wide-leg jeans (full-length)
Minimal sneakers or dance shoes
Male outfit:
Minimal, stylish streetwear (plain t-shirt or fitted shirt + tailored pants or jeans)
Clean sneakers
Neutral tones to complement the female outfit
Clothing should show natural fabric movement during spins and transitions.
[SETTING]
A minimal, aesthetic empty street:
European-style or modern urban alley
Clean pavement, soft architectural elements
No crowd, no vehicles, no clutter
Background kept subtle so focus stays on dancers
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short move title (e.g., “Step 6 – Spin Lead”)
Center: Full-body pose of both dancers interacting
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides for both dancers
[DANCE PROGRESSION EXAMPLE]
Facing Start Position
Hand Connection & Prep
Side Step Sync
Cross Step Transition
Lead & Follow Shift
Spin Lead (female turn)
Catch & Reconnect
Mirrored Footwork
Half Turn Together
Back Step & Pull
Lifted Arm Turn
Close Frame Movement
Traveling Step
Quick Spin Combo
Final Turn Out
Ending Pose Together
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Curved arrows → spins and turns
Straight arrows → directional steps
Circular guides → rotational movement
Dual arrows to show lead/follow interaction
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and precise anatomy. Clean linework, polished concept-art finish, and clear readability in every panel.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no extra people, no clutter, no outfit changes. Maintain same characters, same outfits, and consistent proportions across all 16 panels.

title: Character Promotion Poster Framework

- Faithfully reflect the reference image design (hairstyle/face/outfit/motifs)

- Hierarchical structure with 'large top, small bottom'

- Lower half: Full-body character placement
- Stable standing pose or light movement

- Multiple elements contained within the giant silhouette

- Building a narrative

[World-Building Expression]
- Multiple scenes based on the character's worldview
- Placement of symbolic motifs
- Movement or staging of smaller characters
- Environmental details (nature/architecture/atmosphere)

[Layout (Left-Right Composition)]
- Complementary elements placed on the left and right
- Providing rhythm to the composition
- Creating narrative tension

[Gaze Direction Design]
- A single visual line flowing from top to bottom

- Continuous visual guidance design

[Margins & Edge Treatment]
- Large use of negative space
- Edge effects: ink bleeding, soft blur, fragmentary decomposition

[Aesthetics & Concept]
- Reflecting Eastern aesthetics: negative space, presence, imperfection

- Unified visual appearance

[Finish Quality]

- Completion level suitable for a poster series

title: Manhwa Style Fighting Storyboard
content:
Generate a high-quality cinematic storyboard collage in a 16:9 frame, composed of 8–10 connected panels. The entire image should be illustrated in a {{art_style}}, with clean line art, soft cel shading, dynamic action composition, and expressive visual storytelling. Avoid photorealism. Do not use realistic human facial rendering. Keep faces slightly simplified, stylized, and illustrated, while maintaining attractive character design and strong emotional expression. No text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark.

Scene concept:
A freestyle fight between a man and a young Chinese woman, with the woman clearly winning in the end. The tone is intense, stylish, energetic, and dramatic, with strong visual rhythm and clear action storytelling. The setting should be clean and minimal, such as {{setting}}, a modern training arena, or an empty industrial platform.

Female lead:
A young adult Chinese woman in her early 20s, clearly adult, illustrated in a Korean comic style. She wears a {{outfit}} with a fashionable, feminine look. Her design should feel youthful, agile, and confident. She has a light and nimble build, clear body lines, a slim and toned silhouette, and graceful but powerful movement. Her expression and posture should communicate calmness, sharp focus, and quiet confidence.

Male opponent:
An adult man with a physically stronger and more aggressive presence. He should appear forceful and intimidating at first, creating a visual contrast with the woman’s agility, technique, and composure.

Storyboard progression:
Panel 1: Wide establishing shot. The man and the woman stand apart in a tense face-off, dramatic atmosphere, strong composition.
Panel 2: Close-up or medium shot details — stylized eyes, hands tightening, ready stance, subtle body tension before the fight begins.
Panel 3: The man attacks first with aggressive speed and force.
Panel 4: The woman dodges smoothly and precisely, using quick footwork and agile body movement.
Panel 5: A fluid exchange of action — blocks, slips, pivots, and evasive movement, shown with dynamic comic-style angles.
Panel 6: The fight intensifies. The woman remains calm and starts reading his rhythm.
Panel 7: Turning point. She finds an opening and counters with clean, skillful technique.
Panel 8: A visually striking action moment — spin, redirect, sweep, or takedown — showing her taking control.
Panel 9: The man is down or clearly defeated, breathing heavily or collapsed.
Panel 10: Final hero shot. The woman stands strong and composed under dramatic lighting, calm and victorious.

Visual style:
Korean manhwa / webtoon-inspired illustration, cinematic comic storyboard, polished line art, soft cel shading, dramatic lighting, dynamic motion, expressive posing, elegant action choreography, stylish panel composition, clean background design, high detail, vivid but controlled color palette

title: 3D Rendered Dance Sequence Guide
content:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use image1 as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: same as in refrence image, bottom wears baggies trouser The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements.

title: Anime World Building and Character Sheet
content:
[Desired Output]
World-building Setting Materials + Original Anime Character Setting Materials
*Please visualize not only the character but also the environment, culture, systems, technology, and sense of daily life of the world in which the character lives.

[Worldview Seed]
Enter here

[Number of Proposals]

[Setting/Environment]
Enter here

[Society/Systems]
Enter here
*Design community rules, division of labor, status markers, affiliation marks, exchange methods, and rituals that fit the input.

[Technology/Faith/Taboos]
Enter here
*Derive material processing, recording methods, communication, prayers, taboos, festivals, and body decorations naturally from the input content.

[Lifestyle/Culture]
Enter here
*Housing, diet, transportation, work tools, clothing styles, meaning of ornaments, seasonal events, currency, script, emblems, etc.

[Overall Atmosphere]
Enter here

[Characteristics of the World]
Enter here

[Key Priorities]
Enter here

[Finish Direction]
Enter here
*E.g., emphasize realism/life-like feel, emphasize mysticism, emphasize practical utility of costumes, focus more on architecture, target bright children's content, etc.

[Differentiation Instructions]
Enter here

[Drawing Tone]
Smooth line art, flat anime coloring, minimal cel shading, single-level shadows, no gradients, no thick painting, no realistic texture expressions, no strong light/shadow effects, flat look optimized for animation.

[Anime Conversion Instructions]
While maintaining the structure, motifs, color scheme, roles, and cultural meanings of the original design, simplify the drawing for production animation. Use flat anime coloring and keep shadows to one level. Treat translucent materials or thin fabrics as simplified surfaces in a cel-shaded style rather than realistic textures.

Based on the input above, create an image in the style of "World-building Setting Materials + Character Setting Materials" for an original anime.

Purpose:
To visually communicate the world itself in which the character lives, rather than just the character alone. Create setting materials where the world's environment, culture, lifestyle tools, architecture, transportation, and the origins of clothing appear as a unified whole.

Most Important:
First, extract a "visual rule" unique to that world from the input content. Reflect that visual rule in everything: backgrounds, architecture, tools, costumes, color schemes, materials, emblems, and the overall page layout.

Desired Finish:
- Clothing, tools, and housing should look like things actually used by people living in this world.
- Characters, backgrounds, tools, text, and material samples should appear to belong to the same cultural sphere.
- Convey unique environments, resources, and lifestyle habits born from the worldview seed.
- Shapes should arise from necessity in daily life rather than existing genre tropes.
- Feature a unique shape language, color palette, and material feel recognizable at a glance.

Thought Process:
1. Determine the world's "Environment" from input (climate, terrain, light, seasons, dangers, resource distribution).
2. Determine "Lifestyle" from environment (housing, food, work, transport, storage, exchange, recording, celebrations).
3. Determine "Clothing and Tools" from lifestyle (fastening, layering, carrying, protection, showing status/role).
4. Determine "Character Appearance" from clothing/tools (focus on outfits, equipment, materials, colors, and silhouettes rather than just face/hair).
5. Determine "Page Design" from visual rules (reflect recording media, patterns, white space, and diagram styles of that world).

Diversity Enhancement:
Invent a new cultural sphere for each input. If multiple proposals are requested, ensure each has a distinct principle of living, material logic, and aesthetic.

For each proposal, significantly vary:
- Terrain and climate appearance
- Architecture and cityscape shapes
- Primary materials
- Meaning of colors
- Costume silhouettes
- How tools are held, stored, and carried
- Creation of symbols, scripts, patterns, and emblems
- Format of the page layout

Ideation Candidates (not fixed themes, but materials for inspiration):
Environment: Arid lands, cold regions, highlands, wetlands, volcanic ash zones, mirror lakes, misty valleys, high-wind zones, polar night, low gravity, floating strata, glowing mineral caves, etc.
Materials: Paper, bone, ceramics, leather, resin, glass, shell, bamboo, straw, crystals, recycled fabrics, lacquer, ash, feathers, amber, etc.
Culture: Oral traditions, mask culture, scent-based ID, knot-script, shadow puppet records, seasonal migration, silence rituals, dance contracts, etc.
Structure: Folding, wrapping, weaving, hanging, inserting, tying, layering, sealing, engraving, bundling, inflating, etc.

Mandatory Elements:
1. Worldview Board (symbolic landscape, cityscape, lifestyle tools, emblems, color rules, shape language).
2. Character Setting Materials (full-body standing pose, role-conveying outfits, detail diagrams for equipment/back view/belongings).
3. World-Character Connection (ensure clothes/gear logic stems from the world's tech/faith/environment).
4. Page Design (layout varies with worldview, using appropriate diagram methods and minimal labels/symbols).

Quality Standards:
- Not generic fantasy; the world's origins must be visible.
- Cohesive culture across characters and backgrounds.
- Decorations must have lifestyle, faith, or functional meanings.
- Visual differentiation between multiple world proposals.

Visual Presentation:
- High resolution, anime style, delicate line art, clean cel painting.
- Mixed layout of world boards + full-body character + tool details.
- Minimal text, prioritizing visual concept art sheets.

Final Goal:
Ensure a design where the world's establishment, resident life, material constraints, cultural meanings, and community rules are palpable. Create a unified sense where backgrounds and characters are instantly recognizable as belonging to the same unique world.

Use a black to deep charcoal background with subtle texture, faint vertical ribbed wall detail on the right, glossy floor reflections, and elegant neon-lime accent lighting mixed with warm gold highlights.

title: Luxury personal color profile layout
content:
LUXURY PERSONAL COLOR PROFILE — EDITORIAL LAYOUT
Studio portrait of subject as anchor — skin retouched to luminous glass-like perfection, preserved natural structure, realistic pore texture, soft directional key lighting, no facial alteration. Background: warm ecru parchment with subtle linen grain texture. Layout reads like a Vogue Italia beauty supplement printed on heavyweight matte stock. Structured editorial grid, 3-column asymmetric, wide negative space, serif condensed display headers, all labels in spaced uppercase tracking, cohesive warm ivory/sand/ecru background system throughout all panels, ultra-photorealistic 8K, soft diffused studio lighting, flat elegant surfaces, no drop shadows.
PANELS:
① UNDERTONE DIAGNOSIS — Tonal spectrum bar from cool ash to warm amber, precision needle marker on subject's reading. Labels: Cool / Neutral-Cool / Neutral / Neutral-Warm / Warm. Fine annotation text.
② SEASONAL COLOR PALETTE — 10–12 fabric-textured swatches in subject's optimal season. Each labeled with poetic color name and HEX. Grouped: Power Colors / Softest Options / Harmonizing Neutrals.
③ COLORS TO AVOID — Desaturated row of clashing tones with fine editorial strikethrough. Clean, non-harsh presentation.
④ MAKEUP CARTOGRAPHY — Eyeshadow gradient dust swatches / blush tones fanned on skin strip / lip spectrum barely-there to bold / highlighter finishes labeled: champagne, rose gold, pearlescent ivory.
⑤ HAIR COLOR SPECTRUM — Curved gradient strip: base, dimension, highlight, contrast tones. Gold bracket indicators on best options.
⑥ JEWELRY & METAL GUIDE — Flat-lay editorial render: yellow gold, rose gold, oxidized silver, platinum finishes alongside complementary stone tones. Minimal styling.
⑦ YOU IN YOUR PALETTE — 3–4 editorial lookbook frames, subject in palette-correct outfits. Mood labels: Quiet Luxury / Off-Duty Editorial / Evening Presence.
⑧ CAPSULE WARDROBE GRID — Outfit flatlay: tops, bottoms, outerwear, shoes, bag — all palette-correct. Coordinating lines showing interchangeability. Net-a-Porter editorial aesthetic.
⑨ PRINTS & PATTERNS — 4 fabric print thumbnails: micro geometric, tonal abstract, classic stripe, floral scale. One-line styling note per print.
⑩ STYLE ARCHETYPE — Single typographic panel. Style identity title set large (e.g. "Modern Romantic / Warm Classicist"). Three defining aesthetic words. Four-line editorial wardrobe philosophy note.
RENDER SPECS: Ultra-photorealistic, 8K, editorial magazine print quality, warm neutral color grading, soft diffused studio lighting consistent across all panels, one serif display font + one fine sans-serif body font, no gradients, flat matte surfaces only.

title: Muscle Lobster Spinach Comic
content: A vintage single-panel comic illustration in a mid-century newspaper-cartoon style, showing an anthropomorphic red lobster standing on a wooden dock by the sea and posing like a bodybuilder. The lobster is the only character and fills most of the frame, facing slightly left with an angry, proud expression, narrowed eyes, long curved antennae, whisker-like mouth feelers, huge exaggerated claws, an enormous hyper-muscular torso, oversized biceps, thick chest, and a sharply defined six-pack and obliques. One claw is raised in a flexing pose near a large speech bubble. The speech bubble in the upper left contains exactly this hand-lettered text in bold black comic lettering: “I YAM WHAT I YAM! and I YAM RIPPED!” with “RIPPED!” emphasized larger and underlined. At the lobster’s feet, slightly left of center, place 1 opened can labeled “SPINACH” with green spinach visible inside and the lid peeled back. The dock includes 1 wooden mooring post wrapped with rope on the far left. In the background, show calm blue water, a bright blue sky, and 4 fluffy white clouds spread across the top area. On the far right background across the water, include 1 small cannery or factory building on pilings with a sign reading “SPINACH” and 2 smokestacks, one releasing a puff of gray smoke. Render it with flat comic colors, bold black outlines, slightly aged paper texture, light ink imperfections, and a humorous parody tone reminiscent of 1930s–1950s Popeye-era animation art.

title: Book Summary Infographic Poster
content:
Generate a [medium information density] book summary infographic poster with the theme "{{book_title}}".

---

Step 0 (Critical Pre-assessment)

Before starting generation, determine which category this book belongs to (multiple choice possible):
* Cognitive Growth (Thinking / Self-improvement)
* Business / Wealth (Earning / Career / Investment)
* Psychology / Emotion (Relationships / Inner Self / Human Nature)
* Novel / Story (Narrative / Character / Metaphor)

Adjust content logic based on category.

[Overall Style]
Modern Minimalist UI + Light Vintage Illustration style. Soft light backgrounds (Cream / Beige / Light Gray). Low saturation palette (Deep Green / Deep Blue / Brown).
Keywords: Quiet, Substantial, Readable.

[Core Principles]
Do not use fixed module titles. Do not force structural completeness. Organize information naturally based on book type.

[Content Modules]
1. Opening: Book Title, Author, One-sentence insight.
2. Core Understanding: "What this book is really saying is..."
3. Highlights: Key takeaways adjusted by category.
4. Visual Structure: Decision paths, leverage systems, or character maps.
5. Examples/Fragments: Memorable scenes or cases.
6. Quotes: Meaningful sentences.
7. Actions: Practical steps to take after reading.

[Design Details]
Adaptive grid layout, card-based info, 6:4 image-to-text ratio, unified illustration style, clear hierarchy.

[Tone of Voice]
Should sound like a human explaining the book with insight and realization, not like a dry summary.

title: Martial Arts Choreography Poster
content:
A clean instructional poster in a 4x4 grid (16 panels) showing a male martial artist demonstrating Pencak Silat choreography. The subject is a fit man with medium-length dark hair and a beard, wearing a red button-up shirt, beige pants, and white sneakers. Style is semi-realistic illustration mixed with hand-drawn sketch lines, soft shadows, and a light textured paper background. Each panel includes subtle motion arrows and small captions. Minimalist, balanced layout. शीर्ष title at top: 'Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill'.

Panel 1: wide ready stance, knees bent, one hand guarding forward, focused expression.
Panel 2: step forward with outward block, arm extended defensively.
Panel 3: inside block sweeping upward diagonally, torso rotating.
Panel 4: strong straight punch forward, aligned hips.
Panel 5: side step into low stance, both hands pushing outward.
Panel 6: knee lifted high in chamber position, balanced posture.
Panel 7: front kick extended forward, opposite arm guarding.
Panel 8: step backward into defensive cover, arms crossing.
Panel 9: low block, sweeping arm downward in deep stance.
Panel 10: hook punch across body with hip rotation.
Panel 11: turning body with pivoting feet, circular motion.
Panel 12: forward palm strike, stable stance.
Panel 13: low sweeping motion near ground in squat stance.
Panel 14: rising smoothly from low stance, upward motion.
Panel 15: controlled locking pose, one arm raised defensively.
Panel 16: closing salute, feet together, hands pressed at chest, calm posture.

Include hand-drawn arrows (blue and purple accents), clean infographic layout, evenly spaced panels, consistent character design across all frames.

A focused male martial artist performs a smooth, flowing Pencak Silat sequence in a minimalist studio. He is in his late 20s, athletic build, medium height, warm tan skin, with thick wavy dark hair and a short, well-groomed beard. He wears a fitted deep red button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, beige slim-fit pants with slight wear at the knees, and clean white sneakers. His expression is calm, controlled, and intent. 
The setting is a softly lit neutral studio with an off-white textured backdrop and a slightly worn wooden floor. Lighting is diffused and cinematic, creating gentle shadows and emphasizing fluid motion.
The choreography is continuous and rhythmic, with no abrupt cuts: 
0–2s: يبدأ in a grounded ready stance, knees bent, one palm forward in guard, eyes locked ahead 
2–4s: steps forward into an outward block, transitioning into an inside sweeping block upward 
4–6s: rotates hips into a straight punch, then shifts weight into a side step with a pushing motion 
6–8s: lifts knee smoothly and extends into a controlled front kick, maintaining balance 
8–10s: steps back into a guarded cover, drops into a low block, then rises into a hook punch 
10–12s: pivots the body with a clean turn, transitioning into a forward palm strike 
12–14s: lowers into a sweeping motion, then rises fluidly into a locking control pose 
14–15s: finishes upright with a respectful closing salute, hands together at chest level 
Movement style is soft, flowing, controlled, with precise martial intention rather than aggression. Emphasis on balance, breath, and continuity. Camera is a steady medium-wide shot with subtle slow tracking, no cuts.

The foreground is a flat stone or plaster courtyard in shadow with subtle texture. No people, no furniture, no decoration, no text. title: Tianjin City Promotional Poster Prompt
content:
A 2026 Tianjin city promotional poster filled with a festive Spring Festival atmosphere, while combining elegant style and urban cultural heritage.
The overall image uses a 'Guochao' (national tide) illustration + double exposure artistic technique. The composition continues an S-shaped flow, with natural and smooth visual guidance, combining modern design sense with Eastern aesthetic charm.

On a pure white high-grade textured background, the image maintains large areas of white space, making the overall feel fresh, elegant, and transparent.
In the bottom right corner stands a miniature figure in traditional Chinese clothing, with a dynamic posture, waving a long red silk dance ribbon.
This red silk has a soft, elegant, and tense texture, spiraling upward in the air and naturally extending to the top left, forming a highly visually impactful flow trajectory.

As the red silk extends, it gradually transforms into a magnificent Haihe River water vein, while integrating the cultural context and geographical imagery of Tianjin, like an urban scroll connecting the past and present.
In the visual subject formed by the intersection of this 'river' and the silk, a hand-drawn panoramic map of Tianjin city is overlaid, in Guochao style, with rich layers, magnificent momentum, and exquisite, shocking details.

Key landmarks and urban elements of Tianjin are highlighted in the frame:
Tianjin Eye (prominent landmark, highly recognizable)
Haihe River (core water system running through the frame)
Jiefang Bridge (embodying urban history and industrial beauty)
Jinwan Plaza architectural complex (showing modern urban prosperity)
Century Clock (iconic landscape)
Ancient Culture Street (embodying traditional culture)
Five Great Avenues villa complex (embodying the historical style of blending East and West)
Drum Tower (embodying Tianjin's ancient charm)
Italian Style District (adding urban romance and exotic flavor)
Tianjin Port and ocean freighter elements (embodying the city's character of openness, port, and global connectivity)
Appropriately integrate cultural symbols like Yangliuqing New Year paintings, Niren Zhang clay sculptures, crosstalk culture symbols, and fried dough twists (Mahua) as decorative details to enhance regional identity.

The entire image presents a visual mood of 'river, city, bridge, port, and the fusion of past and present,' with light clouds and misty water vapor, carrying the ethereal feel of Eastern aesthetics.
Colors are mainly Chinese red, gold, elegant white, green, and light blue, with warm gold accents in some areas; the overall feel is festive but not vulgar, rich but not cluttered.

Image Requirements:
Rich details, complex structure, clear layers.
The city landscape is fully visible, providing a sense of shock and artistry.
Maintain a Spring Festival atmosphere, modern aesthetics, and promotional poster quality.
Obvious hand-drawn feel, exquisite and beautiful, with collectible visual quality.
Has both the momentum of a city promotional film poster and the high-end feel of tourism posters.

Text Layout Requirements:
Elegant typography in the bottom left for the English title: 'SPRING 2026'.
Accompanied by vertical Chinese promotional slogans, such as:
'River and Sea Jinmen, Charming Tianjin'
or
'Jinmen Hometown, Open Tianjin'
or
'Ancient and Modern Fusion, Myriad Tianjin'.

Text Requirements:
Beautiful and generous layout.
Clear and complete handwriting.
High-end poster design sense.
Harmonious combination of Chinese and English.
No garbled characters, no typos.

Overall Meaning:
Showcase the unique charm of Tianjin as a famous historical and cultural city, an important northern port city, and a modern international metropolis, reflecting the charm of the Haihe River, the ancient charm of Jinmen, and the open and inclusive urban spirit.

Poster Size: 9:16 vertical.

title: Chinese Portrait Photography Book Page
content: Create a clean, premium Chinese editorial book page for a photography tutorial, portrait orientation, minimalist magazine-style layout on an off-white paper background with generous margins and refined typography. The page is a single spread-like design with 5 clearly separated content blocks: a top header, a left text column, one large main portrait on the right, a bottom-left lighting diagram, and a bottom-right area containing 2 thumbnail examples plus 1 tip box. In the top header, place small Chinese text reading "人像摄影实战指南 | Chapter 04 光线与影响的运用". On the upper left, make a large chapter number in muted olive green reading "04-2", followed by a bold black Chinese title split across multiple lines: "自然光下的\n柔美人像". Below it, add a smaller olive-green subtitle: "利用花影与漫射光\n营造温柔氛围". Under the subtitle, include a short Chinese paragraph in black body text describing how natural surroundings and flowers or tree shadows can soften sunlight and create a clean, gentle, atmospheric portrait. Below that, create a section titled "● 拍摄要点" in olive green, followed by 3 numbered tips in Chinese body text: 1 "光线方向" with a sentence about choosing top or upper-side natural light and using floral shadows to soften facial contours; 2 "前景与氛围" with a sentence about using large soft foreground flowers to frame the scene and add depth; 3 "表情与情绪" with a sentence about guiding the model to keep a natural, calm expression and relaxed gaze. On the right side, place one large vertical portrait photo occupying the upper-right half of the page: a soft, airy close portrait of a young East Asian woman with long straight black hair, wearing a pale blush pink top and a delicate necklace, surrounded by abundant white hydrangea-like blossoms in the foreground and overhead, lit by diffused natural daylight with floral shadows and a gentle romantic mood, shallow depth of field, elegant editorial photography. Beneath the main photo, add a single line of small technical camera settings text in Chinese: "● 焦距：85mm   光圈：f/2.8   快门：1/640s   ISO：100   白平衡：自动". In the bottom-left block, place a rounded-corner box containing a simple black-and-white hand-drawn lighting diagram with the title "● 布光示意图". Inside the diagram show 3 elements: a small sun icon at upper left, a camera icon at lower left, and a rear-view sketch of a standing woman centered, with dotted directional lines from the sun and labels in Chinese explaining that natural light from above front is softened by flowers into dappled diffused light, with flowers used as foreground and medium telephoto compression for a virtualized scene. In the bottom-right area, add a section title "● 更多尝试" in olive green above 2 small vertical thumbnail portraits of the same woman among white flowers. Give each thumbnail a short Chinese caption: left "侧光拍摄，光影层次更强", right "逆光拍摄，增加通透感". To the far right of the thumbnails, place a rounded rectangular tip box with the title "✦ 小贴士" and a short Chinese note advising to avoid direct harsh midday light and prefer soft light in the morning or late afternoon for a gentler image. Add a small page number "086" at the bottom left. Use elegant Chinese book typography, muted olive green accents, black body text, subtle gray divider lines, high-end publishing design, balanced whitespace, realistic print layout, and polished professional book typesetting.

title: Detailed Animal Encyclopedia Generation
content:
[Animal Name]
{{animal_name}}

[Objective]
Complete a large-format animal encyclopedia plate at a sellable quality level as a single illustration. Generate a publishing-quality plate that balances scientific accuracy with visual appeal.

[Output Format]
- Include all information in one image
- Aspect Ratio: 16:9
- Quality: High (essential for ensuring precision of small text, fine lines, and labels)

[Screen Design Principles]
Layout, zoning, information priority, margin design, typography, decorative elements, and color palette should all be determined autonomously by GPT based on the animal's characteristics, habitat, and classification. Design a layout best suited for this specific animal without being bound by templates.

[Essential Elements to Include]
Integrate the following elements naturally into one frame:

1. Main Specimen Drawing
- Full body of adult depicted with maximum precision
- Scientifically accurate colors, patterns, and proportions
- Scientific name (italicized), common name, and classification info (Order, Family, Genus)
- Scale bar or size comparison

2. Growth/Development Record
- Step-by-step illustration of changes from juvenile to adult
- Concise labels for each stage

3. Ecological/Behavioral Depiction
- Action scenes in natural environments (foraging, predation, breeding, territoriality, etc.)
- Include habitat vegetation and terrain in the background

4. Morphological Details
- Close-ups of characteristic parts (claws, fangs, feathers, scales, eyes, etc.)
- Magnified depictions of surface textures

5. Distribution/Habitat Range
- World or regional distribution map
- Description of habitat types

6. Data Notations
- Length, weight, lifespan, diet, conservation status (IUCN, etc.)
- Easy-to-read table or icon format

[Style Specification]
- Publisher-quality natural history encyclopedia
- Realistic botanical/naturalist painting touch (19th-century naturalist precision + modern color expression)
- Paper texture: Cream-colored hot-press watercolor paper or parchment style
- Font: Unified serif. Scientific names in italics; data can use mixed small sans-serif fonts
- Border: Thin ink border + classical plate decoration
- Overall color scheme, layout tone, and page design optimized by GPT based on habitat, classification, and ecology

[Most Important Instruction]
Deeply understand the unique ecology, cultural significance, and taxonomic features of this animal to design a page that feels like it was "made just for this animal." Visualize the essence of the animal rather than using a generic template. Ensure all text is actually rendered within the frame, leaving no empty labels.

title: Retro Pop-Art Comic Strip
content: A 4-panel comic strip in bold retro Sunday funnies / 1980s pop-art style, thick black outlines, halftone textures, vibrant saturated colors (hot pink, cyan, yellow, teal), dynamic comic lettering. Main character: A stylish young woman with {{hair_color}} hair, wearing oversized black sunglasses and a {{clothing}}. Confident expression, glossy lips, dramatic lighting. Secondary character: A cute chibi-style character in a full penguin costume (dark blue body, white belly, yellow beak hood), big sparkling eyes, small body, playful and mischievous vibe. Panel 1 (close-up, bold intro): Zoomed-in portrait of the woman, hair slightly blowing. Bright comic burst background. Text: “THE WIND IS NO MATCH FOR MY SHADES!” Speech bubble: “Bring it, breeze.” Panel 2 (beach chaos begins): Beach setting with strong wind—palm trees bending, hat, towel, and drink flying. Woman standing confidently. Penguin character appears at the side. Text box: “BEACH DAY!” Speech bubble: “Ha! Nice try, wind.” Small penguin text: “awk!” Panel 3 (wind intensifies): Stronger gusts—trash can tipping, seagull mid-air, debris flying. Woman still composed, hair dramatically flowing. Penguin laughing mischievously. Text box: “STRONGER!” Speech bubbles: “Is that all?” / penguin: “hee hee!” Panel 4 (final punchline): Reveal a big electric fan wearing sunglasses blasting air dramatically. Woman surprised. Penguin proudly next to fan. Text box: “ULTIMATE BOSS.” Speech bubbles: “Wait… no!” Big comic text: “YOU GOT BLOWN AWAY!” Caption at bottom: “RESPECT THE FAN.”

title: Anime Pokémon Shop Outfit Teaser Poster
content: A dreamy pastel anime fashion announcement poster set inside a bright Pokémon merchandise shop. The composition is vertical and split visually into two zones: a large translucent information panel on the left and a full-body character showcase on the right. The scene has a soft, elegant, airy atmosphere with diffused indoor lighting, creamy highlights, gentle reflections on the polished floor, and a refined shoujo illustration style. In the background, show a clearly recognizable Pokémon store interior with display shelves, the Pokémon logo sign, a large Poké Ball emblem on the wall, potted plants, plush toys, and figures; visible Pokémon merchandise includes exactly 3 prominent character plushies or mascots: Pikachu at the bottom right, plus 2 small shelf plushies resembling Piplup and another pastel blue-green character. The girl stands slightly right of center in a graceful fashion pose with one leg crossing in front of the other, one hand lightly raised near her chest, and the other relaxed outward. Her face is intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur block. She has long wavy {{hair_color}} hair with loose curls and a delicate feminine look. She wears a refined pastel outfit: a frilled white high-neck blouse with layered ruffles, a light blue sleeveless pinafore-style dress with a fitted waist and a flowing mid-calf flared skirt, a small white crossbody purse with a flap, white ankle socks, and glossy black Mary Jane shoes. Add subtle pink earrings. The outfit should feel classy, fresh, and cute, with gentle fabric movement. On the left, place a frosted semi-transparent poster panel with elegant typography and decorative flourishes. Include exactly 5 text blocks or labeled areas on this panel: 1) a top banner with Japanese text "次回衣装プロンプト公開" above large cursive English text {{headline_text}}; 2) a name block with Japanese text "セラス・柳田・リリエンフェルト" and smaller romanized text "Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld"; 3) a teaser line reading "次回の衣装も お楽しみに！" with a small Poké Ball icon; 4) a bordered description box titled "Next Coordinate" followed by several lines of small Japanese body text; 5) a bottom ribbon reading {{footer_text}} and "STAY TUNED!" with a small Pikachu silhouette. Use pale blue, white, silver-gray, and blush pastel tones throughout. Add faint ornamental corner decorations and a polished promotional layout, like a boutique fashion teaser poster for a themed anime character outfit reveal.

title: Fox-Eared Streetwear Boy in Steampunk City
content: A highly detailed anime-style illustration of a fashionable fox-eared young man sitting casually on the edge of a floating industrial platform in a vast vertical steampunk city. He has messy layered {{hair_color}} hair with a small streak of deep magenta near one side, 2 large fox ears with pale inner fur, and a fluffy cream-colored fox tail curling behind him. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat square censor block centered over the face. He wears a glossy black bomber jacket embroidered with scattered floral patterns in 2 colors, red-pink and violet-blue, with ribbed cuffs and collar striped in dark red and black. Under it is a black graphic T-shirt with ornate gold lettering and emblem details, partially hidden by layered straps and necklaces. His outfit includes loose black cargo-style pants with zipper details, black socks with small gold lettering, and chunky black platform shoes with bright magenta laces. Add multiple silver rings, black suspenders or harness straps with metal buckles, and a long olive-gold hanging belt strap draped off the platform. Pose him in a relaxed seated posture with 1 knee raised and 1 leg extended diagonally downward, left arm resting over the raised knee and right hand planted beside him. The mood is cool, urban, and slightly rebellious. The background is an intricate labyrinth of towering pale teal and off-white mechanical structures, stacked platforms, scaffolding, hanging chains, exposed cables, suspended boxes, and several round clocks embedded in the architecture, creating a dense vertical futuristic-steampunk environment fading into atmospheric haze. Use soft daylight, muted pastel industrial colors, fine linework, delicate ink-and-watercolor rendering, crisp fabric highlights, and a polished contemporary anime illustration aesthetic.

Highlight the 4 right-side outlets with a green outline group and individual green outlines, and place 4 numbered green labels on the right: "1 Servidor 1", "2 Servidor 2", "3 Servidor 3", "4 Switch (mover aquí)". On the left, highlight the currently used upper-left outlet with an orange outline and add an orange callout box reading "Switch: mover de aquí", plus a curved arrow from that outlet to the bottom outlet of the right-side green group. title: Luxury Concept Poster Design
content:
What you will generate is not a regular illustration, but a high-end concept poster that expresses the meaning and symbolism of the person and name "{{person_name}}" as a visual metaphor.

Place the giant letters "{{person_name}}" as the main protagonist of the entire screen. The letters should be thick, powerful sans-serif characters with an overwhelming presence. The background should be {{background_color}}, and the characters a slightly yellowish off-white, with paper texture, graininess, and light scuffs like vintage silkscreen printing or old posters.

At the bottom center, place a monochrome portrait of a man reminiscent of Elon Musk. It should have an atmosphere similar to the person himself, with an expression looking up at the future. The face should not be too realistic, but expressed with strong shadows in a print/poster style.

In the upper right, include a composition where a rocket is launching diagonally upward. Use {{accent_color}} as an accent color for the rocket's exhaust flames and smoke, and have it pass through the giant letters as if cutting through them. This visualizes the meaning of "breaking through to the future," "breaking through existing frameworks," and "large-scale challenges."

Make the overall design a minimalist and powerful graphic poster. Do not add too many elements; compose it only with the text, the person, the rocket, and the red smoke. The composition should be bold and designed to leave an impression at a glance, even from a distance.

In the lower left, add small auxiliary text like "VISION / SCALE / MOTION," and in the lower right, "BUILD THE FUTURE." You may discreetly place small symbols associated with Tesla or X if necessary, but the main focus remains the symbolism of the name "ELON MUSK" and the person.

Unify the colors around three main colors: black, off-white, and red. Create a concept poster with a strong visual memory that conveys luxury, futurism, ambition, solitude, a sense of scale, and the energy of destruction and creation.

title: Dance Choreography Instruction Sheet
content:
Dance Sequence Instruction Sheet
[VISUAL STYLE]
A composition featuring a highly detailed 3D-rendered female dancer. Designed like a professional choreography guide with a technical, diagram-inspired layout. Clean white background, soft studio lighting, and strong contrast to highlight body movement and posture.
[GRID LAYOUT]
Structured 4×4 panel grid (16 frames total), evenly spaced with thin black divider lines. Each panel is identical in size and clearly numbered from 1 to 16 to show a continuous dance progression.
[CHARACTER]
Use {{reference}} as the base character. The same female dancer appears consistently across all panels with accurate likeness and proportions.
[WARDROBE]
The dancer wears a stylish, performance-ready outfit: a {{clothing}}. The look should feel modern and visually appealing while still practical for dance movement. Fabric should subtly respond to motion (slight flow and folds), even in grayscale.
[PANEL STRUCTURE – EACH FRAME]
Top-left: Step number + short dance move title (e.g., “Step 5 – Spin Transition”)
Center: Full-body pose capturing a precise moment in the choreography
Bottom-left: 3–4 lines of concise instruction describing the move
Overlay: Motion arrows and directional guides illustrating how the dancer transitions
[MOTION INDICATORS]
Incorporate curved arrows for fluid motion, straight arrows for directional steps, and circular indicators for spins or turns. Emphasize rhythm, weight shifts, and body isolation.
[RENDER QUALITY]
High-detail sculpted 3D style with smooth grayscale shading, subtle shadows, and clean linework. Maintain a polished, concept-art level finish with clarity in every pose.
[RESTRICTIONS]
No color, no background scenery, no extra characters, no visual clutter, only the dancer and instructional elements..

title: French New Wave Protest Film Poster
content: Create a vintage French New Wave political cinema poster as a torn-paper collage, vertical one-sheet composition, aged and distressed like a weathered 1968 street poster pasted on a wall. Use a limited palette of cream paper, faded black, deep red, mustard yellow, and muted cobalt blue, with heavy analog film grain, halftone print texture, ink bleed, fold creases, scratches, rough paper fibers, ripped edges, glue stains, and slightly misregistered letterpress typography. In the center, place a large black-and-white portrait of a brooding young man in a dark coat, seen in three-quarter profile, cropped from chest up, with curly dark hair and his face partially obscured by a rectangular censor-like paper block, giving the image a mysterious art-house feel. Surround the portrait with torn collage fragments: at upper left, a red paper panel with a black silhouette of a running protester; beneath it, a narrow off-white text strip reading “PARIS, MAI 68” and smaller French copy “LES MURS ONT DES OREILLES, L’AVENIR AUSSI.”; along the far left edge, a vertical black film-strip border with “36 KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM” in white; at lower left, a mustard-yellow torn panel with a cropped dark silhouette portrait; at upper right, a blue torn panel containing the quote “UN FILM COUP DE POING ET DE POÉSIE.” with “— CAHIERS DU CINÉMA” below; directly below that, a tall black-and-white photo fragment of a lone figure walking down a wet Paris street at night under lampposts; near the middle-right, a small torn newsprint block with the French slogan “LA BEAUTÉ EST DANS LA RUE” above a crowd scene; at lower right, a red torn panel with a black silhouette of a domed Paris landmark. Across the very top, centered in narrow black capitals, add the tagline “NOT EVERY REVOLUTION IS TELEVISED.” Near the lower middle, in small black condensed type, add “A FILM BY {{director_name}}”. Make the main title dominate the lower half in huge condensed red uppercase letters over torn cream paper: “{{French_title}}”. Directly underneath, in smaller blue condensed capitals, add the English subtitle “{{English_subtitle}}”. At the bottom center, place a black strip with large white condensed capitals reading “COMING SOON”, and below it smaller text “ÉTÉ 1968”. In the bottom left corner, include a Cannes-style laurel mark with “SÉLECTION OFFICIELLE FESTIVAL DE CANNES 1968”. In the bottom right corner, add tiny production credits in French, including “UNE PRODUCTION LES FILMS DU SOLEIL DISTRIBUTION”. Keep the whole design asymmetrical, raw, rebellious, and elegant, evoking Godard, Truffaut, May 1968 protest graphics, and handmade French art-house poster collage.

title: Minimalist Educational Infographic Template
content:
A clean educational infographic poster explaining "{{topic}}".

[Overall Style]
Modern minimalist UI style, background in soft light colors (e.g., cream #FAF7F2 / light gray-blue), restrained and comfortable color palette suitable for long reading sessions.

[Core Requirements (Key)]
Naturally organize content modules based on the information structure of the "topic". Do not force a fixed number or order of modules; prioritize clear logical information over formal symmetry.

[Layout (Adaptive)]
- Use grid layout (auto-select 2 columns / 3 columns / irregular distribution)
- Card count adjusts based on content (usually 5–9)
- High information density modules can be enlarged (higher visual weight)
- Simple modules can be shrunk or merged

[Card Design]
- White cards (#FFFFFF)
- Rounded corners + subtle shadows (soft layering)
- Maintain uniform spacing and alignment

[Each Information Module Includes]
- Simple illustrations (unified style)
- Clear headings (strong hierarchy)
- 1–3 core explanatory sentences (avoid wordiness)
- Examples / comparisons / summaries provided where necessary

[Content Organization Principles (Emphasis)]
Auto-select appropriate structure based on theme, e.g.:
- Concept type → definition + principle + characteristics + example
- Contrast type → A vs B (comparative structure)
- Process type → steps / flowcharts
- System type → components + relationships
- Skill type → methods + tips + common mistakes

[Visual Hierarchy]
- Title > Module Title > Main Text > Supporting Information
- Important info can be highlighted with color or icons

[Color Suggestions]
- Primary color: Choose based on theme (Tech=Blue, Learning=Green, Warning=Orange)
- Secondary colors: 1–2 types suffice
- Avoid high saturation and flashiness

[Style Requirements]
- Generous negative space, strong sense of "breathability"
- Unified icons (linear or flat)
- High readability as priority
- Clear educational orientation

[Extra Optimization (Optional)]
- Can include: comparison blocks / process arrows / structure diagrams
- Can have a "Core Summary" module as a visual finale.

To the right inside the same lower area, include a smaller rounded box with line-art icons of cutlery, a drink, and a burger, plus Japanese copy that reads "モスのこだわり" and "おいしさは、まごころから。" followed by smaller explanatory Japanese text.

Across the bottom, place a large curved banner with a teal gradient and white center glow containing the Japanese slogan "今日はモスに寄り道しよう。" with "モス" highlighted in bold red. Near the lower right, add a small orange-red circular callout with Japanese text similar to "あなたのお気に入りがきっと見つかる!". Use a crisp commercial poster layout, vivid teal, aqua, white, pink, and gold accents, glossy food rendering, decorative sparkles, and a premium collaboration feel between anime fantasy illustration and modern restaurant advertising.

title: Ethereal Buddhist Pure Land scene
content:
The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.

title: Isometric Micro-World Cross-Section Archive
content:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density visual map of an 'Isometric Micro-World Archive' suitable for serialized publishing based on the [Theme].

This is not a regular room illustration or a simple architectural drawing, but a thematic space overview combining 'isometric perspective + architectural cross-section structure + multi-layer functional space + high-density thematic props + miniature model feel + game scene concept art feel.' The image should look like an opened miniature world, a business simulation game scene, a dollhouse model, or a world-building concept map, allowing viewers to understand the overall structure at a glance while repeatedly observing the small details within.

[Basic Settings]
Theme: [Theme, e.g., Insect Research Institute / Future Survival Base / Magic Potion Workshop / AI Automation Company / Plant Factory / Children's Learning Center / Space Supply Station]
Space Name / Brand Name: [Brand name or space name, can be empty]
Worldview Direction: [Reality / Sci-Fi / Fairy Tale / Magic / Post-Apocalyptic / Museum / Laboratory / Business Simulation / Campus / Natural Ecology]
Building Type: [Cottage / Base / Factory / Lab / Shop / Museum / Underground Space / Spaceship / Multi-layer Studio]
Core Function: [What this space is mainly used for, e.g., research, production, display, life, training, trading, learning, maintenance, planting]
Main Color: [Main color, e.g., light blue, mint green, cream yellow, pink, orange-green, purple-blue, white-blue tech color]
Auxiliary Color: [Auxiliary color, can be empty]
Accent Color: [Accent color, can be empty]
Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 3:4 / 4:5 / 9:16]
Information Density: [Medium-high / High / Ultra-high]
Overall Vibe: [Healing, cute, precise, childlike, popular science, futuristic, retro, refreshing, sense of exploration]

If some fields are not filled, please automatically derive them reasonably based on the [Theme]; do not leave the screen blank. All content must be generated uniformly around the theme, avoiding irrelevant elements.

[Visual Structure]
Adopt a clear isometric perspective / axonometric view, where the main subject is an opened multi-layer thematic building or functional base. Viewers can simultaneously see the front, side, top, and internal space of the building. The entire building is located at the center of the screen, occupying most of the area, with the background environment moderately faded to highlight the subject.

The interior of the building needs to be divided into multiple functional areas, each with a clear purpose, rather than randomly piled decorations. It can include:
1. Main work area / Core operation area
2. Display area / Collection area / Specimen area
3. Research area / Lab area / Control area
4. Storage area / Shelving area / Supply area
5. Living area / Rest area / Small residential area
6. Energy area / Machine area / Piping area
7. Planting area / Cultivation area / Ecological area
8. Entrance area / Transport area / Maintenance area
9. Spatial connection structures like stairs, platforms, corridors, railings, ladders, etc.

Clear spatial relationships must be formed between various areas through stairs, corridors, platforms, pipes, bridges, or cables, making the image look like a real, functioning miniature system.

[Props and Details]
Generate a large number of relevant props based on the [Theme] and distribute them in different functional areas. Props need to be specific, identifiable, and thematically related, not just vague decorations. Each small object should be as clear and readable as a game asset, with a feel of being clickable, interactive, and collectable.

Types of props can include:
- Thematic equipment: machines, instruments, tools, consoles, containers, screens, workbenches
- Lifestyle objects: tables/chairs, bookshelves, beds, cups, boxes, cabinets, lamps
- Display objects: specimens, models, posters, signboards, glass cabinets, display racks
- Connection structures: pipes, wires, ladders, stairs, conveyor belts, slide rails, platforms
- Ecological elements: plants, water tanks, incubators, soil, branches, rocks, specimens
- Character elements: small number of characters, animals, robots, or thematic creatures to provide a sense of scale and story

The number of props should be rich but orderly. All props should serve the space's function and the thematic worldview.

[Style Requirements]
The overall style is clear, cute, precise hand-drawn cartoon isometric illustration. Lines are clean, edges are slightly rounded, colors are bright and soft, with an overall relaxed, healing, and exploratory feel. The image should have the feel of a business simulation game, a children's science picture book, a miniature model, or a concept art page.

Avoid over-realism, strong dark lighting/shadows, heavy oil painting feel, and complex noise. The focus is on being clear, exquisite, layered, and highly readable.

[Color and Lighting]
Use high brightness, low-to-medium saturation soft color schemes. The main color is unified, auxiliary colors are used to distinguish different spaces, and accent colors are used to highlight key equipment and small props. Line art colors should not use dead black; instead, use soft outlines like dark gray, blue-gray, or brown-gray.

Keep lighting and shadows lightweight; strong realistic projections are not needed. Build layers through color blocks, structures, lines, and local highlights. The background should use light colors and low-contrast processing to make the main building stand out more.

[Composition and Reading Path]
The main subject is centered or slightly upper-centered, with the building in a multi-layer cross-section structure. The visual reading path should start from the overall building outline, enter the functional areas of each floor, and finally observe the detailed props. The gaze can be guided by elements such as stairs, platforms, corridors, pipelines, and tracks.

The overall image should be full but not crowded, rich but not messy. Every room, platform, and corner should have content, yet still maintain clear spatial boundaries.

[Background Environment]
The background can include a weakened external environment according to the theme, such as a forest, city, street, underground rock layer, experimental park, seabed, space, campus, factory exterior, etc. The background should not compete with the subject; light colors, low opacity, and low contrast are recommended to achieve a 'subject clear, background receding' effect.

[Final Effect]
The final image should look like a complete thematic space concept map, with both the structural feel of an architectural cross-section and the detail of a game scene asset map, combined with the cute exploration feel of a miniature dollhouse. It should be suitable for serialized visual creation, IP worldview display, game scene settings, brand space concept maps, science content covers, or Little Red Book/Pinterest style visual posts.

Ensure the image has:
1. Clear isometric perspective
2. Clear architectural cross-section structure
3. Complete multi-layer functional areas
4. Rich props and thematic unity
5. Soft and bright colors
6. Clean and clear line art
7. Weakened background, prominent subject
8. High information density but not messy
9. A sense of an explorable, operable, and observable miniature world.

If the [Subject Type] is Urban Space:

If the [Subject Type] is Mixed Landscape:

The camera observes the entire model board from about 30 to 45 degrees above, allowing the audience to see the map plane, 3D subject height, edge thickness, and explanation areas. The visual focus is on the central main model, with the reading path being: first the core subject, then the surrounding terrain/road/water/block information, and finally the legend, scale, and explanation area.

[Material and Lighting]
The overall look needs realistic model photography texture:

- Soft natural light
- Delicate realistic shadows
- Clean background
- Low saturation, high-end, and restrained
Avoid cartoonishness, cheap game UI feel, excessive clutter, or excessive showboating. Highlight the unified visual of "map base board + 3D subject + professional explanation system."

title: Pixel Game Asset Atlas Template
content:
Please create a high-completion, high-information-density "Pixel World Asset Atlas" suitable for serialized release based on [Game Theme: {{game_theme}}].

This is not a regular pixel illustration or a single game scene, but a "2D pixel game asset overview map" for game development, art setting, level design, and visual proposals. The visual should look like a complete game material board, systematically organizing core characters, enemies, items, terrain, scenes, mechanisms, Bosses, and decorative elements required for a [Game Type: {{game_type}}] into a single clear, professional, and reusable game asset atlas.

[Basic Settings]
Theme Worldview: [Game Theme]
Game Type: [Game Type]
Era Background: [Era Background]
Protagonist Identity: [Protagonist Identity]
Enemy Types: [Enemy Types]
Main Scenes: [Main Scene Environment]
Overall Style: [Style Direction, e.g., {{style}}]
Main Color: [Main Color]
Secondary Color: [Secondary Color]
Accent Color: [Accent Color]
Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, Landscape 4:3]
If not filled, automatically match according to the optimal plan for the game theme.

[Overall Visual Requirements]
The visual uses a large landscape canvas with a light or low-interference background, looking like a game development asset sheet or an instruction-style resource catalog. All elements should be 2D pixel art sprites with uniform pixel density, clear black/dark outlines, limited color scales, and retro game textures. Do not generate realistic photography, 3D rendering, painterly illustration, or movie poster styles. Focus on being "systematically complete, clearly categorized, resource-rich, and high in developability."

[Layout Structure]
The map uses a modular grid layout with fine lines dividing different resource areas. Each area needs a numbered title and short category labels, with a reading path from left to right, top to bottom. The layout should have the orderliness of an instruction manual or game dev document. Information density must be high but not chaotic; elements within each module should be equidistantly arranged.

[Modules to Include]
1. Player Character Module: Show complete action frames including standing, walking/running, jumping, etc. frames arranged horizontally like a sprite sheet.
2. Enemy Unit Module: Design multiple enemies including common, ranged, heavy, and elite units.
3. Weapons & Items Module: Show melee, ranged, projectiles, effects, and pickups.
4. Basic Terrain Tile Module: Show ground, walls, platforms, corners, and different material blocks.
5. Natural/External Scene Resource Module: Show trees, grass, rocks, and obstacles.
6. Building/Base/Camp Resource Module: Show doors, windows, walls, ladders, and camp facilities.
7. Special Terrain Module: Show bridges, water bodies, cliffs, and cave openings.
8. Indoor/Underground/Facility Resource Module: Show pipes, consoles, metal doors, and equipment.
9. Boss / Encounter Resource Module: Show large Bosses, special vehicles, and giant mechanisms.
10. General Decoration & Interaction Elements Module: Show ladders, ropes, signs, switches, and mechanisms.

[Visual Detail Requirements]
All resources must maintain consistent pixel size logic and worldview consistency. Clear scale relationships. Action frames must show continuity; terrain tiles must be tileable; items and mechanisms must have functional recognizability; Boss elements should feel oppressive.

title: Japanese Realist Romance Movie Poster
content: 日系现实主义爱情电影海报风格，灵感来自《花束般的恋爱》，一对二十岁左右的日本年轻情侣站在城市日常场景中（街头或路口），彼此之间保持微妙而真实的距离，没有肢体接触，像关系逐渐疏远的瞬间。情绪安静克制，带未说出口的情感与时间流逝感。构图为电影主视觉，人物位于画面下方或一侧，画面保留大面积留白，强调空间与空气感。光线为自然光（阴天或黄昏），低饱和灰蓝、米色与暖灰色调，真实摄影质感。画面带细腻胶片颗粒与轻微生活感，不刻意唯美，不过度修饰，像真实电影中的一帧。可在画面边缘或前景加入少量自然花材作为隐喻（克制、不过度、不装饰化）。在留白区域加入标题「花束みたいな恋をした」，细明朝体，排版简洁疏朗；下方小字号加入《花束般的恋爱》。整体要求：真实日本电影海报质感，文艺、克制、生活化，强调关系而不是浪漫符号，避免甜腻爱情表现，避免花朵堆砌，避免网红唯美，避免构图拥挤，避免“精致但空洞”的AI感。AI感，过度唯美，花海，浪漫滤镜，光效泛滥，高饱和，霓虹灯，情侣亲密拥抱，摆拍感，大头贴构图，网红风，插画感，3D渲染，元素堆砌。日系极简文艺电影海报风格，灵感来自《情书》，冬季雪地场景，一位年轻女子的脸部特写，面部贴近雪地或半埋在雪中，细小雪花自然落下。构图为克制的近距离侧脸或微偏角度面部，人物占画面较大比例但不过度清晰锐利，边缘轻微柔化或轻微失焦。表情为伤心之后的平静，眼中带泪或泪痕，情绪内敛、克制、像刚刚哭过又慢慢恢复安静，眼神不看镜头，带回忆与空白感。光线为冬日自然散射光或阴天柔光，冷白、浅灰、淡蓝色调，低饱和、低对比，无强阴影、无戏剧光效。雪地与空气形成干净背景。画面质感为真实摄影与胶片之间，带轻微颗粒、轻微雾感、略微泛白或轻微过曝，像一张被时间冲淡的旧照片或电影静帧。皮肤不过度细节，不磨皮、不锐化、不精修。构图不对称，可局部裁切面部，背景极简，保留适当留白。在留白区域加入极简标题「Love Letter」或「ラヴレター」，细明朝体或细衬线字体，字距拉开、排版疏朗，颜色为浅灰；下方极小字号加入《情书》。整体要求：真实日本文艺电影海报质感，安静、含蓄、克制，像一段被雪覆盖的记忆，避免写真感、避免网红审美、避免精致滤镜、避免光效、避免高对比高饱和、避免锐利数码感、避免情绪表演化、避免“好看但空洞”。AI感，磨皮，锐化，HDR，高对比，高饱和，梦幻光效，光斑，滤镜感，写真风，网红脸，摆拍，直视镜头，情绪夸张，3D渲染，插画风，复杂背景。

title: Professional Brand Packaging System
content:
Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {{brand_name}} in the category {{category}}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.

title: Epic Shiva Tandava Fire Dance
content: A monumental mythological fantasy painting of Lord Shiva performing the Tandava in the center of a fiery sacred arena, full-body, dynamic dancing pose with one leg raised and the other foot pressing down on a fallen figure beneath him. Shiva has ash-blue skin, a powerfully muscular physique, long wild flowing dark hair exploding outward in all directions, a high matted topknot, and a white crescent moon tucked into the hair. His expression is intense and divine. A cobra is coiled around his neck, and he wears multiple rudraksha bead necklaces, bracelets, and armlets, large circular earrings, and sacred ornaments. His clothing is a tiger-skin loincloth with dramatic red-orange cloth sashes whipping through the air. One raised hand holds a small damaru drum, one front hand is lifted in a blessing gesture with the Om symbol visible on the palm, and another hand conjures a bright flame above the open palm. Behind his head is a large glowing circular halo inscribed repeatedly with Sanskrit mantra text, creating a radiant mandala effect. The setting is an apocalyptic Himalayan temple landscape with dark storm clouds, smoke, embers, rocky mountains, waterfalls, and ancient stone shrines and temple towers on both the left and right sides. A trident wrapped with red cloth stands upright on the left side of the scene. Around Shiva is a circle of exactly 10 worshippers and ascetics, split across both sides, shown chanting, kneeling, raising arms, carrying torches, and playing drums in devotion. Beneath Shiva is exactly 1 fallen dark-skinned male figure lying on the stone ground. The ground is cracked and molten, with a blazing ring of lava and fire encircling the dance platform. Use dramatic cinematic lighting, glowing orange firelight against deep charcoal shadows, highly detailed anatomy, intricate jewelry and textures, swirling hair and fabric motion, devotional epic fantasy realism, painterly brushwork, symmetrical central composition, ultra-detailed, high contrast, vertical poster format.

title: Seaside Cafe Event Poster
content:
Create a lively Chinese event poster with a warm, trendy coffee-shop aesthetic, photographed from inside a seaside cafe looking out through large floor-to-ceiling windows at palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should feel like a candid lifestyle scene combined with energetic graphic design. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with 1 open laptop centered near the bottom, 1 takeaway coffee cup with a black lid on the right side of the table, 1 black bag on the left, and 1 short stack of books near the left edge. Use a sunlit, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass and a relaxed vacation vibe.

Overlay bold poster graphics in a collage style using torn paper, brushstroke paint, stickers, and taped note-paper elements. The main headline on the upper left should be huge, hand-painted Chinese calligraphy in dark brown and orange, reading “疯狂星期四”, with a small yellow tag near it that reads “第11期”, and an even smaller top-left badge reading “活动预告” with a tiny megaphone icon. Beneath the main headline, add a green brushstroke banner with the text “下周四，不见不散！”, and below that a smaller line in parentheses: “（五一长假前最后一期）”.

Add 2 torn notebook-paper cards: 1 in the upper right and 1 in the lower left. The upper-right note should contain a short invitation paragraph in Chinese, neatly typeset in black and orange text, reading: “让我们海边小聚，远眺摩天轮，吹吹海风，和 App & AI Builder 们一起聊聊产品、远程生活与创作。” and include a small orange heart doodle in the bottom-right corner of that note. The lower-left note should list 3 info blocks with icons and orange section headers: “时间”, “地点”, and “说明”. Under “时间”, write “2026年04月23日 (星期四)” and “12:00 ~ 18:00”. Under “地点”, write “南山区·前海石公园·福叁咖啡”. Under “说明”, write “无需报名，随时来吧！”.

Across the middle-right area, place a large playful white script-style slogan with a dark outline, angled slightly upward, reading “喝咖啡、随意交流 海边散步，主打一个 Chill~”. Add 1 illustrated coffee cup sticker next to this slogan on the right. Use energetic orange paint splashes and sketch doodles around the headline and notes to make the poster feel youthful and spontaneous.

At the bottom, place a wide off-white torn-paper footer strip containing 3 feature blocks laid out horizontally. Block 1: a snowflake-like icon with the text “舒适环境” and smaller text “空调 + 宽敞桌椅”. Block 2: a Wi‑Fi icon with the text “电网无忧” and smaller text “WiFi + 插座”. Block 3: larger orange handwritten text “期待与你 海边相遇！” with a blue underline flourish and a tiny heart doodle. The overall design should mix real photography and graphic poster elements, with strong contrast, brush lettering, scrapbook textures, cafe lifestyle realism, and a fashionable AI-generated social-media event-poster look.

title: Food Lifecycle Infographic Prompt
content:
An educational infographic themed "Life of {{food_name}}."

The image must feature "a single complete food item" (such as a potato / a bunch of bananas / a head of garlic), using horizontal slicing to show the changes of the same food at different time stages, rather than a collage of multiple different items.

The main food body maintains structural continuity and consistent shape, presenting different levels of maturity in different slice areas (like time being sliced open).

The image is in vertical 3:4 ratio, with the main subject centered and horizontally expanded, evenly divided into 4-6 segments:

Each segment reflects real changes:

Color changes (green → yellow → black, etc.)
Texture changes (plump → softened → shriveled → decayed)
Feature changes (sprouting, weeping, mold, etc.)

Each stage is accompanied by text descriptions:

Stage name
Appearance characteristics
Internal changes (sugar/starch/moisture changes)
Consumption suggestions (recommended/suitable for cooking/inedible)

Design style:

Minimalist light background (beige)
Highly realistic photography style
Clear dividing lines (sense of time slicing)
Chinese educational layout, Little Red Book style
Appropriate use of icons like ⚠️✔️

Title at the top: "Life of {{food_name}}"

Key requirement: It must be presented as "slices of the same food item changing over time," not a collage of independent individuals.

content: A dramatic UFC fight-poster style sports promotion for {{event_title}}, designed as a high-contrast vertical matchup graphic with two female MMA fighters facing inward in orthodox guard poses. The left fighter is a fit blonde woman with shoulder-length messy beach-wave hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly right. The right fighter is a fit dark-haired woman with long straight black hair, tan skin, a black sports bra, black UFC gloves, and black fight shorts, shown from upper thigh to head, turned slightly left, with a large detailed black-and-gray tattoo sleeve on her right arm and script tattoo text on the inner upper arm. ONE OCTAGON." Along the far left edge, place the surname "SWEENEY" vertically in large distressed gold letters; along the far right edge, place the surname "FOXX" vertically in large distressed silver-gray letters. Below that, add a small gold subtitle reading "BANTAMWEIGHT BOUT". At the bottom center, show a small realistic UFC octagon cage seen from a slightly elevated front angle, embedded into the poster. Use a glossy premium combat-sports poster finish, cinematic rim lighting, gritty texture overlays, metallic typography, and intense face-off composition.

title: Nostalgic 2003 Family Apartment Photo
content: A candid, unprocessed indoor photograph taken with an early 2000s consumer digital camera or cheap film camera. The image features a {{family_description}} in their {{living_room_description}} circa {{year}}. A mother, father, and young daughter (around 6) are captured in a cluttered, genuine setting. The mother is looking up, surprised and smiling, while the father is trying to fix an old VCR player, and the daughter is playing with a colorful toy car on the patterned rug. The shot is clearly spontaneous, taken with poor, natural window light from the right. The composition is off-center, slightly blurry and grainy with muted, washed-out colors and a yellowish tint. In the background, there's a bulky beige TV showing static, a wall calendar from 2003, cluttered shelves with VHS tapes, framed family pictures, a cloth sofa, and maybe a small plant. The perspective is from eye level but feels handheld and shaky. The focus is soft, and the depth of field is shallow, emphasizing the natural moment. Shot with an old Nikon Coolpix or Canon PowerShot, visible digital noise and a time-stamp in a corner. The shot captures a slice of mundane, everyday life, with the daughter's messy hair and toys scattered, creating an authentic, memory-like feel.

title: Rainforest Clearing with Speckle Artifacts
content: An ultra-detailed wide-angle rainforest clearing photographed from a very low ground-level perspective, with the camera almost at the edge of a shallow muddy puddle.
