The foreground is slick with brown water, leaf litter, and reflective puddles, including a fallen branch stretching diagonally across the lower right area and a rounded mossy rock on the lower left. The center opens into a patch of low green plants, while the background rises into thick jungle canopy. Bright midday sunlight breaks through the treetops in the upper right, creating strong rays, haze, glowing highlights, and high contrast against a partly cloudy blue-and-white sky visible through the canopy. Use a dramatic fisheye or ultra-wide lens effect with subtle barrel distortion, immersive environmental scale, rich saturated greens, wet textures, realistic natural lighting, crisp foliage detail, and a photorealistic documentary nature-photography look. Include a faint, unnatural grid-like speckle noise artifact pattern across the image, especially visible in darker foliage and muddy ground, as if from an image-generation quality bug.

title: Cute Winter Anime Channel Poster
content:
A cute pastel anime promotional poster in a dreamy idol-fanclub style, landscape orientation, featuring a single horse-girl character from the waist up on the right side of the composition. She has {{hair_color}} long fluffy hair with side-swept bangs covering one eye, one large visible sparkling purple-pink eye, fair skin, soft blush, and upright horse ears with a large cream bow tied between them. Her expression is gentle, shy, and welcoming, with a small smile and a slight head tilt toward the viewer. She wears a thick red scarf with white horizontal stripes, a cream cable-knit sweater, and a navy sailor-style inner collar with a small red ribbon at the chest. The overall color palette is warm pink, cream, beige, and cocoa brown with soft winter lighting.

Design the image as a Japanese fan-content announcement graphic with layered sticker-like typography, fluffy outlines, hearts, sparkles, and snowflake motifs. The background should be a softly blurred cozy winter café or warmly lit indoor scene with glowing bokeh and pale decorative textures. Add exactly 5 major text areas: a pink ribbon banner at the top with the Japanese text "ライスと一緒に"; a very large central-left headline in rounded pop lettering reading "ほのぼの 育成" with "ほのぼの" in pink and white and "育成" in bold brown with white stitched edging; a small dark ribbon under it reading "しよっ♪"; a circular brown badge on the right reading "初見さん歓迎"; and a logo-like label at bottom right reading "ライスシャワーちゃんねる" with a small horseshoe icon. Add exactly 1 memo pad in the bottom-left corner with 3 checklist lines, each with a pink checkmark: "ストーリー", "チャンミ", and "まったり雑談". Include small decorative pink hearts around the character, tiny accent lines near her head, white snowflakes, lace-like trim, paper-cut corner decorations, and a soft scrapbook aesthetic. Make the whole piece look like an adorable fictional stream or channel thumbnail welcoming new viewers, highly polished, clean anime line art, soft shading, glossy eyes, and charming commercial poster composition.

title: Hand-drawn Travel Journal Illustration
content:
Please draw a brightly colored, vertical (9:16) hand-drawn style "{{city_name}} Travel Journal Illustration." The style should look as if it were created with crayons by a curious child. Use a soft and warm light-colored background (such as light yellow), paired with bright tones like red, blue, and green, to create a cozy, child-like, and travel-inspired atmosphere.

I. Main Image: Journal-style Travel Route

Draw a "winding travel route" in the center of the illustration, connecting multiple locations with arrows and dashed lines. Recommended attractions will be automatically generated based on a {{number_of_days}}-day itinerary:

Example format (automatically replaced with {{city_name}} related content):

- "Stop 1: {Attraction 1 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 2: {Attraction 2 recommendation + short fun description}"
- "Stop 3: {Attraction 3 recommendation + short fun description}"
- ...
- "Final Stop: {Local signature food/souvenir + warm closing statement}"

The number of travel stops is automatically generated based on the number of days. If no days are input, a 1-day/highlights route will be generated by default.

II. Fun Surrounding Elements (Automatically replaced based on the city)

Add plenty of child-like elements around the route, such as:

- Cute travel characters: "A child holding local snacks," "An adventurous kid wearing a backpack," etc.
- Child-like Q-version hand-drawings of local landmarks: such as "{landmark 1}," "{landmark 2}," "{landmark 3}."
- Fun signboards: "Watch out for getting lost!", "Mind the crowds!", "Good food ahead!" (Adjusted according to city context).
- Sticker-style slogans: "{{city_name}} Travel Memories Unlocked!", "{{city_name}} Food Adventure!", "Where to next?"
- Cute small icons of local delicacies: such as "{food 1}," "{food 2}," "{food 3}."
- Exclamations (maintaining a child-like tone): "{{city_name}} is so much fun!", "I want to go again!"

III. Overall Style Requirements

- Hand-drawn crayon style / children's travel log style
- Bright colors, full but warm composition
- Emphasis on the joy and exploration of travel
- All text uses cute handwritten fonts
- Make the entire image look like a travel journal page full of child-like wonder.

title: Countryball Hormuz Strait Standoff
content: A humorous political meme illustration in a simple countryball cartoon style, showing the current situation at the {{location_label}} as a narrow chokepoint. Use a wide landscape composition with bright flat colors, thick black outlines, and a clean hand-drawn infographic-like look. In the foreground, place 2 countryballs standing shoulder to shoulder on an extremely narrow sandy land bridge with rocks along both sides, making it obvious that only one can pass at a time. On the left is a {{left_country}} countryball painted with the American flag, wearing black sunglasses and a brown cowboy hat, facing the other ball with a stubborn attitude. On the right is an {{right_country}} countryball painted with the Iranian flag, wearing a dark turban-like hat, with angry slanted eyes, also refusing to move. Add 2 large white speech bubbles, one beside each countryball, and put the same bold Korean word in both bubbles: {{speech_bubble_text}}. In the midground and background, show a busy blue sea crowded with 9 ships total: 2 gray US warships on the far left, 1 Chinese submarine with a red Chinese flag, 4 oil tankers lined up in the center-left and center carrying different national flags, and 2 gray military ships near the narrow passage with small American flags. title: Cyber Streetwear Manga Splash Art
content: A dynamic manga-style action illustration of a single androgynous young woman shot from a dramatic low angle, as if the viewer is beneath her while she drops or steps forward through an explosive burst of ink and debris. She has a short platinum-blonde bob haircut with long side-swept bangs partly covering one side of her face, pale skin, and a cool, rebellious streetwear aesthetic. Her face is obscured by a simple light-gray rectangular censor block. She wears 5 main clothing items: an oversized black hooded jacket with bright cyan geometric markings on the sleeve and inner lining, a fitted white tank top, loose black cargo-style pants with straps and zipper details, a black belt with a hanging cyan tag, and chunky white-and-black sneakers with small cyan accents. Add extra accessory details including dangling straps, buckles, and street-tech trims. Her pose is relaxed but dominant, one knee raised toward the viewer, torso leaning back slightly, one hand tucked into a pocket, jacket flaring outward in motion. The composition should feel aggressive and kinetic, with a monochrome palette of black, white, and gray, punctuated by vivid electric cyan paint slashes. Fill the background with explosive abstract brushwork, ink splatter, speed lines, torn black shards, and chaotic manga energy radiating outward from behind her. content: Create a clean minimalist static ad on an off-white light gray studio background with a centered editorial layout. At the bottom center, place a simple black analytics-style bar logo icon followed by the bold sans-serif brand name {{brand_name}}. Use strong text fidelity, polished product-ad composition, soft studio shadows, restrained palette of black, steel gray, off-white, and hot pink, and a modern direct-response ad aesthetic.

title: Editorial SaaS Receipt Ad
content: Create a bold static SaaS ad on a matte black background with a premium editorial look and highly accurate typography. At the top, place a large stacked serif headline in off-white reading: "Your analytics stack" on the first line, "shouldn’t cost more" on the second line in bright magenta italic serif, and "than your rent." on the third line in off-white serif. Center the composition around a large curled, crumpled receipt made of white thermal paper, angled slightly from upper left to lower right, with visible paper texture, soft shadows, and rolled ends on both the upper right and lower left. On the receipt, show exactly 5 line items in black monospaced or receipt-style text aligned in two columns: "GA4" with "$0", "Hotjar" with "$99", "Optimizely" with "$2,450", "GTM setup (dev hours)" with "$1,800", and "Tag manager debug" with "$400". Highlight the word "Optimizely" with a jagged magenta starburst sticker behind it. Add a dashed divider line below the items, then a bold "TOTAL" label on the lower left of the receipt. On the lower right of the receipt, place a large price reading "{{monthly_price}}" in heavy black type, circled with 2 hand-drawn magenta marker loops. Add 3 handwritten magenta annotation elements: on the left side, the words "{{left_annotation}}" in brush script with an underline and a curved arrow pointing to the receipt; near the bottom center, a curved magenta arrow pointing upward toward the circled price; and at the bottom right, the handwritten tagline "{{tagline_text}}" with an underline. In the bottom-right corner, add a small block of white sans-serif body copy, right-aligned, reading "{{body_copy}}". Use an editorial ad-photography style with crisp text placement, clean hierarchy, high contrast, subtle paper realism, and a limited palette of black, white, and hot pink.

title: Minimal SaaS Ad With Invoice Mockup
content: Create a minimalist static SaaS ad on a warm off-white background with elegant editorial typography and clean, high-fidelity text rendering. At the top, place a large black serif headline in two lines reading: "{{headline_text}}" The words “dev team” should appear in italic serif while the rest remains bold high-contrast serif, with generous spacing and a luxury magazine-style layout. Centered below, show a slightly tilted white paper invoice sheet with a soft drop shadow and a subtle vertical fold crease down the middle, as if photographed from above. The invoice uses black monospaced typewriter-style text and reads exactly: “INVOICE — DEV HOURS, OCTOBER” as the header, then 5 line items with hours and prices aligned in columns: “A/B test setup on pricing page   8 hrs   $1,200”, “GTM tag install (3 events)   4 hrs   $600”, “Funnel tracking debug   6 hrs   $900”, “Meta pixel mapping   3 hrs   $450”, and “Attribution reporting build   12 hrs   $1,800”. Under the 5 items, add a dashed divider line, then a bold monospaced “TOTAL” on the lower left and the total price “$4,950” on the lower right. Draw a hand-drawn yellow line striking through the total price. Add 4 doodle-style annotation elements around the invoice: on the left, handwritten yellow text saying “every month??” with a yellow arrow pointing right toward the paper; on the upper right of the paper, a yellow starburst scribble; below the total, a green curved arrow pointing up toward the crossed-out price; and on the lower right, a green hand-drawn circle containing the handwritten words “zero devs,” connected to the green arrow. At the bottom center of the ad, add a smaller black sans-serif body copy in 2 lines reading: “{{body_text}}" Keep the composition airy, premium, and conversion-focused, blending modern startup ad design with tactile paper realism and playful marker annotations.

title: Blurred Deer in Green Forest
content: A painterly wildlife photograph with strong intentional motion blur, showing 1 deer-like animal in a lush green forest clearing. The animal stands slightly left of center in side profile facing left, with a pale tan to cream body, slender legs, and a soft indistinct head and ears, partially emerging from a dark shadowy opening in dense foliage. The entire image is heavily smeared with diagonal and vertical camera motion, creating an impressionistic, dreamlike effect rather than sharp detail. Surround the subject with saturated summer greenery: deep emerald bushes in the background, darker forest shadows near the upper left, and bright vivid grass across the foreground. Use natural outdoor daylight, rich green tones, soft contrast, and an abstract photographic style that feels like a fleeting glimpse of wildlife captured while moving. No people, no text, no buildings, no extra animals.

title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt
content:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {{product_name}}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {{product_name}}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.
description: A highly detailed prompt for creating professional hand-drawn style product packaging design proposals and conceptual mood boards. | Author: Larus Canus (https://x.com/MrLarus) | Source: https://x.com/MrLarus/status/2046788355396968859 | Published: 2026-04-22T03:09:06.000Z

title: Hand-drawn Infographic Card Prompt
content:
Create a hand-drawn style infographic card with a 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. The card has a clear theme and the background is beige or off-white with a paper texture. The overall design reflects a simple and friendly hand-drawn aesthetic.

The top of the card features a large brush cursive font in alternating red and black with sharp contrast to highlight the title and attract visual focus. The text content is all in Chinese cursive, and the overall layout is divided into 2 to 4 clear sections, each using short, concise Chinese phrases to express core points. The font maintains the smooth rhythm of cursive, being both legible and artistic.

The card is dotted with simple, fun hand-drawn illustrations or icons, such as characters or symbolic signs, to enhance visual appeal and trigger thought and resonance in the reader. The overall layout pays attention to visual balance, reserving enough white space to ensure the image is concise, clear, and easy to read and understand.

title: Japanese Hospital Comedy DVD Cover
content: A photorealistic Japanese DVD cover styled like a commercial live-action comedy-thriller release, shot vertically with glossy retail packaging design. The cover shows a hospital room interior with soft beige walls, a bed, curtains on the right, and subtle medical fixtures in the background. In the center foreground, 1 seated young Japanese woman in a loose light-blue hospital gown sits on a bed, looking confused and vulnerable. Around her stand 3 young Japanese female medical staff: 2 nurses in pale pink uniforms with matching nurse caps and ID badges, and 1 doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope. Each of the 3 standing women is holding up a smartphone toward the camera, and each phone screen shows the seated woman’s face or body as if her consciousness has been transferred into their devices, creating a body-jack possession theme. The overall tone is playful, absurd, and slightly eerie, like a Japanese idol movie or hospital comedy DVD jacket. Use a polished magazine-quality layout with bold Japanese typography and colorful pop graphics. At the very top, place a small blue publisher logo on the left reading {{studio_name}} with a heart icon, and a blue DVD VIDEO logo on the top right. Across the top center, add a pink Japanese banner line reading "シリーズ最新作！". Below it, make the main title huge, rounded, glossy, and bubbly in pink and blue Japanese text: {{main_title}}. Under the title, add a pink subtitle in Japanese: {{subtitle}}. Add 3 comic-style speech bubbles near the upper characters: one saying "あなたのカラダ、私たちが使わせてもらうわね", one saying "これで私たちの思い通り♡", and 1 yellow startled reaction near the seated woman that reads "?!". On the left spine area, create a white vertical strip with blue and pink Japanese text repeating the title and subtitle, plus a small pink circle label reading "新作". At the bottom center, place a large flashy Japanese catchphrase in mixed pink, blue, white, and yellow outlined lettering: "人気アイドルのカラダと魂をめぐる、ドタバタ病院コメディ！" with small stars and heart doodles around it. On the lower right, add a blue circular burst with yellow and white Japanese text: "笑って、ドキドキ！悪ノリ注意の病院乗っ取り大作戦♡". Along the bottom edge, include exactly 4 small rectangular preview stills from the film, each bordered like DVD scene thumbnails, showing the same hospital characters in slightly different poses; add short Japanese captions on each thumbnail, including lines similar to "計画はバッチリ！", "え…どういうこと…？", "さあ、始めましょうか♡", and "助けて…私のカラダ…！". In the lower left margin include DVD package metadata in black text such as catalog number "DBJ-002", duration "120min.", "COLOR", and price "¥3,980 (税抜)", plus a small blue-and-pink DRILL logo. Bright retail-ready composition, realistic people, commercial Japanese movie jacket aesthetics, slightly campy, high-resolution, clean print design.

title: Sengoku vs Sangoku Crossover Poster
content:
A dramatic ultra-detailed vertical anime key visual poster showing a crossover war between Japan’s Sengoku era and China’s Three Kingdoms era, split exactly down the center by a glowing vertical beam of light. The left half is themed in crimson, magenta, ember orange, and cherry blossom pink, representing {{left_faction_title}}; the right half is themed in jade green, teal, cyan, gold, and stormy blue, representing {{right_faction_title}}. At the center, large vertical Japanese calligraphy reads {{center_slogan}}. The composition is dense, cinematic, and symmetrical, like a premium game or movie crossover poster, with dozens of sparks, petals, glowing particles, motion streaks, and layered background architecture.

On the left side, depict 4 distinct Sengoku-themed warriors. At the top left, a stern samurai warlord in ornate black and deep red armor with gold trim, long dark hair tied high and blowing in the wind, shown in a powerful upper-body portrait facing inward; behind him are sakura blossoms, banners, and stacked Japanese castles illuminated with neon-magenta highlights. Mid-left, show 1 battle-hardened older general with wild silver hair, heavy layered armor, and a fierce glare, partially emerging from the fortress cityscape. Lower-left, show 1 aggressive crimson-clad warrior lunging forward with sweeping cloth, horned or antler-like helmet ornamentation, and dynamic red-black armor. At the bottom-left foreground, show 1 dominant swordsman in demonic samurai armor with a crescent-moon helmet crest and glowing red eyes, gripping a katana angled diagonally downward, surrounded by embers and petals. A vertical banner near the upper-left edge displays the Japanese text 日本戦国.

On the right side, depict 4 distinct Three Kingdoms-themed heroes. At the top right, show 1 regal strategist-emperor figure in elaborate blue, black, and gold ceremonial armor with a tall crown-like headdress, shown in upper-body profile facing inward; behind him rises a luminous spectral dragon made of water, cloud, and light. Mid-right, show 1 long-bearded green-robed general with a tall headpiece and lamellar armor, solemn and heroic, framed by neon-lit city structures and swirling magical energy. Slightly below center-right, show 1 elegant strategist-scholar holding an opened feather fan, wearing layered robes and gold ornaments, calm and calculating. At the lower-right edge, show 1 roaring armored warrior with a fierce expression and windblown hair. In the bottom-right foreground, make the dominant figure a green-and-gold armored hero extending a glowing jade-green sword toward the viewer, with flowing robes and luminous energy ribbons curling around the blade. A vertical banner near the upper-right edge displays the Chinese text 中国三国.

Blend historical East Asian war aesthetics with futuristic cyberpunk megacity elements: Japanese pagodas and fortresses on the left, neon skyscrapers and glowing urban lights across both halves, flying fortress silhouettes and distant airborne warships in the sky, magical lightning, smoke, and storm clouds overhead. The sky transitions from sunset violet and rose on the left to stormy turquoise and silver on the right. Use hyper-detailed painterly anime illustration, intricate armor textures, metallic reflections, volumetric lighting, high contrast, epic scale, and intense atmosphere.

At the bottom, add huge stylized title typography: on the left, massive fiery kanji 戦国 with the romanization SENGOKU beneath it; in the middle, a metallic gold VS; on the right, massive jade-glowing kanji 三国 with the romanization SANGOKU beneath it. Below that, add a smaller centered subtitle line reading SENGOKU VS SANGOKU, and beneath it a Japanese tagline: {{bottom_tagline}}. title: Japanese Izakaya Highball Poster
content: A photorealistic Japanese izakaya advertisement poster in a warm, cinematic night-time mood, designed like a street-front restaurant flyer. The composition is vertical and densely layered. On the right side, a young Japanese woman with long straight dark brown to black hair, wearing a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, stands from the waist up and holds a large frosty glass mug of golden highball with visible ice cubes in her right hand near chest level. Her pose is relaxed and inviting, looking toward the camera, with a soft nightlife ambiance. The background is a narrow traditional izakaya exterior or interior alley scene filled with warm orange lantern light, shallow depth of field, hanging wooden menu plaques with handwritten Japanese calligraphy, and a nostalgic bustling-after-work atmosphere. In the upper left, a large weathered dark wooden signboard dominates the design, with bold white brushstroke kanji reading 蓮華食堂, small hiragana above it reading れんげしょくどう, and a red brush-painted banner beneath reading 大衆居酒屋. Below that on the left-center, place a large cream-colored paper or painted panel featuring the drink special in oversized calligraphic typography: ハイボール above a huge red 198円, with small black（税込） beside the price, the numerals painted in energetic brush style. Along the far right edge, add vertical white Japanese text reading 今日も一日、おかれさまです。 Near the lower right over the woman’s torso, place a red circular stamp-like badge with white handwritten text arranged diagonally and vertically: 旨い！安い！居心地◎. Across the bottom foreground, show exactly 4 plated menu items lined up side by side on rustic ceramic dishes: 1) two glazed grilled chicken skewers with char marks, labeled 焼き鳥 盛り合わせ and priced 580円; 2) a sashimi assortment with slices of tuna, salmon, white fish, shiso leaves and wasabi, labeled お刺身 盛り合わせ and priced 780円; 3) a plate of fried chicken karaage pieces with a lemon wedge, labeled 若鶏の唐揚げ and priced 480円; 4) sliced rolled dashi omelet topped with chopped green onion and served with grated daikon, labeled 出汁巻き玉子 and priced 380円. At the bottom left, include a glowing red paper lantern graphic with black vertical text 居酒屋. Across the bottom center on a dark band, add large bold white brush lettering reading でかい！うまい！安い！ and below it smaller white text reading みんなの憩いの場、蓮華食堂へようこそ！ Add a decorative red lotus-like emblem near the top sign and another matching emblem in the bottom right corner. Use rich amber highlights, strong contrast, glossy food styling, realistic skin and drink textures, commercial poster polish, and a nostalgic Showa-inspired izakaya promotion aesthetic.

His face is intentionally obscured by a rectangular blurred block, while his hair is dark, wavy, and neatly styled. He holds a stitched traditional-style book against his chest with a vertical cover inscription that includes the large Latin letters "XAI" and 4 Chinese text columns beneath it. His other hand rests on an ornate armillary sphere set on a carved pedestal at the lower left. Behind him is a monumental shanshui landscape of 1 mountain range, layered mist, rocky peaks, and drifting clouds, rendered with fine brushwork in an old master style. In the upper right sky area, place 1 bold modern "XAI" logo with the stylized emblem above the letters, and to the far right include 1 slender rocket launching upward beside a launch tower, with smoke billowing into the clouds, blending futuristic aerospace imagery into the classical scene. On the upper left, add 1 vertical column group of Chinese calligraphy title text in black ink, plus 1 smaller vertical signature line and 2 red seal stamps beneath it. content:
A refined sepia-toned illustration in the style of an ancient Chinese scholarly portrait fused with modern AI branding, on aged parchment paper with visible grain and ink-wash texture. Centered is a half-body portrait of a curly-haired male scholar inspired by Democritus, seated behind a wooden desk and wearing layered traditional robes in muted blue-gray and brown with intricate trim. His face is intentionally obscured by a flat rectangular block in a brown skin-tone color, creating an anonymized or redacted look. He holds 1 calligraphy brush upright in his right hand, while his left hand rests on the table. The rolled scroll at the bottom right should display the phrase “以謹慎之心 創造未來”.

Use a balanced composition, scholarly calm mood, highly detailed ink linework, subtle watercolor shading, antique museum-print aesthetics, and a restrained palette of parchment tan, ink brown, faded blue, and muted charcoal. The overall feeling should be an intellectual tribute poster blending classical East Asian literati painting, philosophical portraiture, and contemporary AI safety themes.

She has extremely long, flowing {{hair_color}} hair, partially seen from the back and side, with an elaborate gold floral hair ornament and dangling chains. Her face is mostly obscured by the angle. She wears a richly layered, ornate Japanese court kimono inspired by a jūnihitoe, with voluminous sleeves and many overlapping panels in crimson, white, purple, green, gold, and soft pink, decorated with floral brocade, embroidered blossoms, metallic trim, and shimmering patterns. Both arms are raised elegantly as she appears to guide 2 huge arcs of translucent iridescent silk or magical ribbon that spiral around her body in a luminous loop, catching rainbow highlights like soap-film aurora light. The ribbons glow with prismatic reflections and tiny sparkles, framing her against the sky. The setting is a moonlit lakeshore covered in fresh snow, with bare winter trees on the right, a small traditional pavilion or shrine structure across the water on the left, and the bright full moon high in a deep indigo sky filled with dense stars and softly falling snow. The water mirrors the moonlight and glittering particles. Emphasize cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere, ultra-detailed fabric textures, dynamic flowing motion, magical sparkle effects, elegant composition, and a dreamlike celestial mood. Highly polished anime key visual, vertical composition, intricate detail, luminous highlights, no text, no watermark.

title: Abstract Chaos Character Art
content:
# Art that reveals a character's face from a chaotic collection of notes and symbols

---

## Style
- Mass of handwritten notes, formulas, symbols, and random lines in black ink on white paper.
- Scribbled chaos scattered across the paper.
- Sporadic emphasis using {{accent_color}} (lines, fills, marker-like blobs).
- Texture of analog notebook doodles.

---

## Composition
- Random notes and symbols cover the entire area.
- The density of black ink lines and characters concentrates on the position of the "character's face."
- As a result, the silhouette and expression of the given character's face faintly emerge from the chaos.
- The face is not realistic but formed by a collection of chaotic fragments.

---

## Color Palette
- Mainly monochrome (black and white).
- {{accent_color}} placed sporadically as an accent.
- Low saturation, emphasizing the feel of analog paper and ink.

---

## Expressive Elements
- Mixed strings of semi-readable Japanese, English, and numbers.
- Mathematical symbols, arrows, dots, slashes, crosses, and ink drips.
- The outlines of the face, eyes, and hair emerge from the "negative space" and "shading" of the symbol placement.

---

## Prohibitions
- Direct, realistic portraits.
- Digitally processed, orderly geometric patterns.
- Colorful or oversaturated expressions.
- Logos, watermarks, or artificial CG aesthetics.

---

## Definition of Done (DoD)
- The whole piece works as a "chaotic collection of notes and symbols."
- The provided character's face naturally emerges from the density and arrangement of chaos.
- Colors are monochrome + {{accent_color}} only.
- Maintains the hand-drawn texture of paper and ink.

title: Vintage Pomegranate Growth Atlas
content:
Create a highly detailed vintage scientific botanical infographic poster on warm ivory paper, styled like a 19th-century natural history atlas plate with modern clean layout refinement. The main subject is a full pomegranate plant, labeled {{plant_name}} / {{latin_name}}, shown centered from crown to roots in a full vertical cutaway-style presentation. Depict a slender woody trunk with many branches, glossy green leaves, several orange-red blossoms, unopened buds, young fruits, mature fruits, one large split-open pomegranate exposing dense ruby seeds, and a fully visible sprawling root system underground. Use delicate watercolor and ink rendering, realistic botanical anatomy, precise linework, subtle sepia shadows, fine leader lines, arrows, and small numbered callout circles. Overall poster title at upper left: {{headline_text}} with English subtitle directly below: {{subtitle_text}}. Add a short introductory bilingual-style text block beneath the title. The composition is a tall 9:16 educational poster with the plant occupying the center and explanatory diagrams surrounding it.

Include exactly 8 numbered educational sections around the plant, each with visible Chinese title and smaller English translation, arranged atlas-style:
1. Seed Architecture — a large cutaway seed diagram with labeled internal parts and a smaller cellular cross-section inset.
2. Germination Mechanism — a left-side sequence of exactly 5 stages showing seed swelling, cracking, sprouting, radicle emergence, and early seedling.
3. Root System + Substrate Intelligence — a large exposed root mass at lower left with exactly 2 circular magnified root-detail insets showing branching structures and root-hair/network texture.
4. Stem, Leaf & Vascular System — a right-middle section with exactly 2 anatomical circular cross-sections and exactly 1 separate leaf illustration, with labels for xylem, phloem, epidermis, and related tissues.
5. Photosynthesis + Energy Conversion — a lower-right biology panel with exactly 3 green microstructure diagrams, including leaf tissue/cell-like sections, plus a simple chemical flow line indicating CO2 + H2O to sugars and O2.
6. Bud Formation + Blooming — an upper-right flowering section with exactly 2 large flower anatomy diagrams, one side view and one longitudinal cutaway, with labeled stamens, petals, ovary, and pollen structures.
7. Pollination + Fruiting Pathway — a right-side development strip with exactly 5 fruit development stages from bud to mature pomegranate, accompanied by a pollination inset featuring a bee approaching a flower.
8. Fruit Maturation + Seed Cycle — a bottom-right lifecycle section with exactly 3 fruit illustrations showing whole fruit, cracked fruit, and opened fruit with scattered seeds, plus exactly 3 seedling progression drawings.

Along the very bottom edge, include a long chronological growth strip with exactly 19 small step illustrations, each numbered in sequence from 1 to 19, showing the plant life cycle from dormant seed through germination, root growth, seedling emergence, sapling development, flowering, fruit set, ripening, seed release, and cycle renewal. Add a small environmental factors panel at lower left with icon-like indicators for light, temperature, water, nutrients, and air. Use bilingual labeling throughout, with Chinese headings more prominent and English translations in smaller serif text. Aesthetic should feel scholarly, elegant, museum-quality, and information-dense, with refined antique typography, muted beige background, realistic reds and greens, and a clean balanced atlas layout.

title: Pose and Lighting Analysis Sheet Transformer
content:
[CORE TASK]
Transform the provided input image into a pose-and-light analysis sheet.

This is NOT a finished character illustration.
This is NOT a clothing sheet.
This is NOT a beauty-preserving redraw.

This is a white-line rough mannequin conversion.

[PRIMARY GOAL]
Extract and visualize only:
- pose structure
- body balance
- camera angle
- body line flow
- inferred light source placement
- illuminated areas and light intensity

[INPUT ROLE]
Use the provided image as the strict anchor for:
- pose
- camera angle
- body tilt
- weight distribution
- approximate lighting situation

Do NOT preserve:
- face rendering
- hairstyle rendering
- clothing detail
- accessories
- weapon detail
- background architecture
- character identity
- emotional expression

[FIGURE CONVERSION]
single rough mannequin-like human figure
white body contour lines
white internal construction lines
simple mannequin head
no face
no eyes
no mouth
no eyelashes
no personality
no individual identity

human figure should look like:
- rough pose mannequin
- anatomy proxy
- line-based body guide
- structural sketch
- white-line rough dummy

keep:
- pose readability
- silhouette flow
- head tilt
- torso direction
- pelvis direction
- limb placement

[BACKGROUND]
pure black background
negative-style dark field
no scenery
no props
no architecture
no environmental storytelling

[LINE STYLE]
rough white line drawing
clean but sketch-like
construction-line feeling
anatomy guide lines visible
joint flow visible
body contour emphasized
no polished illustration finish

[LIGHT ESTIMATION]
predict the likely light source positions from the input image
visualize the light sources and illuminated areas using green glow only

use green light intensity with variation:
- strongest green where the light directly hits
- medium green for wrap light
- soft green for reflected or fading light

mark the estimated light sources with labels and arrows such as:
- Main Light
- Rim Light
- Fill Light
- Floor Bounce
- Back Light
only if appropriate

IMPORTANT:
do not invent random lights
infer lighting from the original input image
if the lighting is ambiguous, keep the annotations simple and plausible

[GREEN LIGHT VISUALIZATION]
show green glow on:
- head / skull plane
- neck
- shoulders
- chest plane
- ribcage direction
- pelvis edge
- thigh planes
- knee contact points
- floor contact bounce if applicable

use green light not as decoration,
but as lighting analysis information

[POSE PRIORITY]
1. preserve pose structure
2. preserve camera angle
3. preserve body balance
4. preserve head-torso relationship
5. visualize likely light direction
6. show illuminated areas with readable green intensity variation

[NEGATIVE]
finished person,
cute girl,
detailed face,
hair rendering,
clothing rendering,
weapon emphasis,
beautiful anatomy

title: Oriental Aesthetics Ink Wash Poster
content:
New Chinese style ink wash landscape poster, vertical 9:16 composition, oriental minimalist aesthetic style. Large areas of white space, overall color palette of a spring morning (cyan-green, misty blue, light gray, pale ink), low saturation, clear and soft, high-end texture. The main subject consists of steep, majestic mountains rising from both sides of a calm lake, occupying the left and right sides of the frame. The mountains are rendered with ink wash techniques showing rich variations in wetness and density, with local pale green tints reflecting spring vitality. Peaks are enveloped in moist, soft morning mist that layers into the pale blue-gray sky, creating atmospheric perspective and spatial depth.

The lake surface is as calm as a mirror with a slight green tint, reflecting the mountains and sky with a soft focus and atomized diffusion effect, enhancing the moist and dreamy spring atmosphere. In the middle ground, a small wooden boat with a curved canopy floats slowly, oars lightly touching the water to create fine ripples that spread naturally, maintaining total stillness. On the boat is a fisherwoman in red, small in scale (distant perspective), simplified into an ink silhouette with light coloring. She wears a low-saturation cinnabar red traditional dress (not bright red), the color softened by the mist. No facial details, only the silhouette and posture (e.g., lightly touching the canopy or holding an oar). The red forms a faint reflection on the water, serving as the only warm visual focus.

The banks are dotted with sparse woods and new spring vegetation, using light ink and pale green dots, combining solid and void to enhance rhythm and life. A few birds soar in the distant sky, lightly and sparsely distributed to enhance spatial hierarchy and nimbleness. title: Graffiti Sketch AI Builder Style
content: Express [{{subject}}] in a graffiti sketch style, presenting an overall visual effect of rapid sketching, free transformation, improvised hand-drawing, and draft-like qualities. Lines are casual, exaggerated, varied in thickness, slightly messy but rhythmic and expressive, emphasizing generalization, exaggeration, fun, and spontaneity rather than rigorous realism or fine detail. Colors use rough, dry-brush block expressions, retaining uneven smears, brush marks, flying whites, and overlapping feelings. Colors automatically adapt to the [theme/subject], but the overall expression remains graffiti-like, sketch-like, and generalized. No transparent watercolor smudging, no delicate watercolor transitions, no paper textures, no soft atomization, and no dreamlike quality. The background is mainly white space, remaining simple, relaxed, unfinished, and design-oriented. A small amount of auxiliary symbols, arrows, marks, circles, repeated lines, handwritten text, or other graffiti elements can be added to enhance the sketchbook or essay-like visual language, but should not be too crowded or destroy the subject and atmosphere of the white space. The image content does not need to be written in advance; the [{{subject}}] will automatically deduce and generate the most suitable main image, actions, related elements, symbols, or simplified scenes. The whole maintains a unified graffiti sketch style and exaggerated generalized expression, avoiding complex realistic backgrounds and over-elaboration. Naturally add a unique signature "{{signature}}" as part of the image, placed discreetly but clearly in the lower-left, lower-right, or near the title. The style should be unified with the overall layout, like an artist's signature or design inscription; the signature font should be refined, restrained, and high-end, not too large, not destructive to the main composition, and not appearing abrupt or cheap.
